5.39.s: yūyaṃ viśvaṃ pari pātha varuṇa mitrāryaman | yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priyā syāma supraṇītayo 'ti dviṣaḥ ||
5.39.d: यूयं विश्वं परि पाथ वरुण मित्रार्यमन् । युष्माकं शर्मणि प्रिया स्याम सुप्रणीतयो ऽति द्विषः ॥
5.39.m: Protect everything completely, / O Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman; / in your shelter may we be dear, / well-guided ones, / across hostilities.

5.39.s: yathā ha tyad vasavo gauryaṃ cit padi ṣitām amuñcatā yajatrāḥ | evo ṣv asman muñcatā vy aṃhaḥ pra tāry agne prataraṃ na āyuḥ ||
5.39.d: यथा ह त्यद् वसवो गौर्यं चित् पदि षिताम् अमुञ्चता यजत्राः । एवो ष्व् अस्मन् मुञ्चता व्य् अंहः प्र तार्य् अग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः ॥
5.39.m: Just as indeed you, O Vasus, worshipful ones, / released that buffalo cow, / so release us from distress; / may our lifespan be lengthened further, O Agni.

5.40.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūto brāhmaṇebhyo nir vapāmi | sa me mā kṣeṣṭa sadam aśyamānaḥ pitṝṇāṃ loke ||
5.40.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रसूतो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो निर् वपामि । स मे मा क्षेष्ट सदम् अश्यमानः पितॄणां लोके ॥
5.40.m: At the impulse of divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, / with the hands of Pūṣan, impelled, I pour out [this oblation] for the Brahmins. / May it never perish for me, forever / in the world of the fathers.

5.40.s: anumataṃ pṛthivyemaṃ pacāmy anu me dyaur manyatām anv antarikṣam | anu manyatām aditir devaputrā ime svarge loke astu ||
5.40.d: अनुमतं पृथिव्येमं पचाम्य् अनु मे द्यौर् मन्यताम् अन्व् अन्तरिक्षम् । अनु मन्यताम् अदितिर् देवपुत्रा इमे स्वर्गे लोके अस्तु ॥
5.40.m: Approved by the earth, I cook this; / may heaven approve of me, and the intermediate space; / may Aditi approve, / whose sons are gods; may this be in the heavenly world.

5.40.s: brahmaṇokhām adhi dadhāmy agnau bhūmyāṃ tvā bhūmim adhi dhārayāmi | agniḥ pacan rakṣatv odanam imaṃ rakṣaḥpiśācān nudatāṃ jātavedāḥ ||
5.40.d: ब्रह्मणोखाम् अधि दधाम्य् अग्नौ भूम्यां त्वा भूमिम् अधि धारयामि । अग्निः पचन् रक्षत्व् ओदनम् इमं रक्षःपिशाचान् नुदतां जातवेदाः ॥
5.40.m: With a sacred formula I place the pot upon the fire; / on the earth I support you, O earth. / Cooking, may Agni protect this rice mess; / may Jātavedas drive away the Rakṣases and Piśācas.

5.40.s: acyutam akṣitaṃ viśvadānīm utsam iva sadam akṣīyamāṇam | pitā pitāmaha uta yas tṛtīyas ta enaṃ bhāgam upa jīvantv atra ||
5.40.d: अच्युतम् अक्षितं विश्वदानीम् उत्सम् इव सदम् अक्षीयमाणम् । पिता पितामह उत यस् तृतीयस् त एनं भागम् उप जीवन्त्व् अत्र ॥
5.40.m: Unfallen, imperishable for all time, / like a spring never running dry, / may father, grandfather, and he who is the third / live upon this share here.

5.40.s: prapīnam akṣitaṃ viśvadānīṃ somam iva punar āpyāyamānam | putraḥ pautra uta yaḥ prapautras teṣām astu nihito bhāga eṣaḥ ||
5.40.d: प्रपीनम् अक्षितं विश्वदानीं सोमम् इव पुनर् आप्यायमानम् । पुत्रः पौत्र उत यः प्रपौत्रस् तेषाम् अस्तु निहितो भाग एषः ॥
5.40.m: Swelling, imperishable for all time, / like Soma filling up again, / may this deposited share / belong to them: son, grandson, and he who is great-grandson.

5.40.s: mā me jārīn nihito bhāga eṣa mānuṣanmānuṣad gupto astu | vaivasvate ni dadhe śevadhim etaṃ tasmā ut sṛjatu mahyam eva ||
5.40.d: मा मे जारीन् निहितो भाग एष मानुषन्मानुषद् गुप्तो अस्तु । वैवस्वते नि दधे शेवधिम् एतं तस्मा उत् सृजतु मह्यम् एव ॥
5.40.m: May this share of mine, deposited, not decay; / may it be guarded. / In the son of Vivasvant I deposit this treasure; / may he release it for me alone.

5.40.s: punaḥ pūryatāṃ yad adanty asya odano 'yaṃ tiṣṭhatv akṣitaḥ sadā | vaivasvatena gupto astu rājñā mamaitor upa jīvantu me svāḥ ||
5.40.d: पुनः पूर्यतां यद् अदन्त्य् अस्य ओदनो ऽयं तिष्ठत्व् अक्षितः सदा । वैवस्वतेन गुप्तो अस्तु राज्ञा ममैतोर् उप जीवन्तु मे स्वाः ॥
5.40.m: Let it be filled again when they eat of it; / may this rice mess remain forever imperishable. / Guarded by the king, the son of Vivasvant, / may my own kin live upon it until my arrival.

5.40.s: śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāram utsam akṣitaṃ vyacyamānaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe | ūrjaṃ duhānam anapasphurantam upāsīya sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ ||
5.40.d: शतधारं सहस्रधारम् उत्सम् अक्षितं व्यच्यमानं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे । ऊर्जं दुहानम् अनपस्फुरन्तम् उपासीय सुकृतां यत्र लोकः ॥
5.40.m: The hundred-streamed, thousand-streamed spring, / imperishable on the back of the water, / yielding nourishment, not faltering, / I would approach, where is the world of the righteous.

6.1.s: tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇaḥ | sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmāḥ ||
6.1.d: तद् इद् आस भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस् त्वेषनृम्णः । सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रून् अनु यं विश्वे मदन्त्य् ऊमाः ॥
6.1.m: That indeed was the eldest among the beings / from which was born the fierce one of glittering valor. / As soon as born he cuts down the enemies, / after whom all the helpers exult.

6.1.s: vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti | avyanac ca vyanac ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||
6.1.d: वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर् दासाय भियसं दधाति । अव्यनच् च व्यनच् च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु ॥
6.1.m: Growing through power, rich in might, / the enemy brings terror to the Dāsa. / Winning both what breathes and what breathes not, / brought forth in the exhilarations, they have roared together to you.

6.1.s: tve kratum api pṛñcanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmāḥ | svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||
6.1.d: त्वे क्रतुम् अपि पृञ्चन्ति विश्वे द्विर् यद् एते त्रिर् भवन्त्य् ऊमाः । स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा सम् अदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः ॥
6.1.m: In you all the helpers combine their resolve / when these become twice or thrice. / Mix the sweeter with the sweet; / thoroughly overpower that honey with honey.

6.1.s: iti cid dhi tvā dhanā jayantaṃ raṇeraṇe anumadanti viprāḥ | ojīyo dhṛṣṇo sthiram ā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan durevā yātudhānāḥ ||
6.1.d: इति चिद् धि त्वा धना जयन्तं रणेरणे अनुमदन्ति विप्राः । ओजीयो धृष्णो स्थिरम् आ तनुष्व मा त्वा दभन् दुरेवा यातुधानाः ॥
6.1.m: Thus indeed the inspired poets applaud you / winning stakes in battle after battle. / More forcefully, O bold one, stretch yourself firmly; / let not the evil-coursing sorcerers harm you.

6.1.s: tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri | codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śyāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi ||
6.1.d: त्वया वयं शाशद्महे रणेषु प्रपश्यन्तो युधेन्यानि भूरि । चोदयामि त आयुधा वचोभिः सं ते श्यामि ब्रह्मणा वयांसि ॥
6.1.m: With you we prevail in battles, / looking forward to many things worth fighting for. / I urge on your weapons with words; / I sharpen your energies with sacred formula.

6.1.s: stuṣeyyaṃ puruvarpasam ṛbhvam inatamam āptyam āptyānām | ā darśate śavasā sapta dānūn pra sākṣate pratimānāni bhūri ||
6.1.d: स्तुषेय्यं पुरुवर्पसम् ऋभ्वम् इनतमम् आप्त्यम् आप्त्यानाम् । आ दर्शते शवसा सप्त दानून् प्र साक्षते प्रतिमानानि भूरि ॥
6.1.m: The manifoldly formed, skillful, / most masterly Āptya of the Āptyas; / he reveals the seven gifts through power, / he conquers many counterparts.

6.1.s: ni tad dadhiṣe 'varaṃ paraṃ ca yasminn āvithāvasā duroṇe | ā mātarā sthāpayase jigatnū ata inoṣi karvarā purūṇi ||
6.1.d: नि तद् दधिषे ऽवरं परं च यस्मिन्न् आविथावसा दुरोणे । आ मातरा स्थापयसे जिगत्नू अत इनोषि कर्वरा पुरूणि ॥
6.1.m: You have laid down that lower and upper [part] / in the house in which you helped with aid. / You establish the two moving mothers, / and you impel many deeds.

6.1.s: imā brahma bṛhaddivo vivakti indrāya śūṣam agriyaḥ svarṣāḥ | maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājo duraś ca viśvā avṛṇod apa svāḥ ||
6.1.d: इमा ब्रह्म बृहद्दिवो विवक्ति इन्द्राय शूषम् अग्रियः स्वर्षाः । महो गोत्रस्य क्षयति स्वराजो दुरश् च विश्वा अवृणोद् अप स्वाः ॥
6.1.m: Bṛhaddiva proclaims these sacred words, / primeval, winning the sun, power for Indra. / He rules over the great enclosure of the self-ruler / and has opened all his own doors.

6.1.s: evā mahān bṛhaddivo atharvā avocat svāṃ tanvam indram eva | svasāro mātaribhvarīr ariprā hinvanti ca śavasā vardhayanti ca ||
6.1.d: एवा महान् बृहद्दिवो अथर्वा अवोचत् स्वां तन्वम् इन्द्रम् एव । स्वसारो मातरिभ्वरीर् अरिप्रा हिन्वन्ति च शवसा वर्धयन्ति च ॥
6.1.m: Thus the great Bṛhaddiva Atharvan / spoke of his own body as Indra himself. / The sisters roaming with the mother, spotless, / both urge on and increase [him] with power.

6.2.s: ṛdhaṅmandrayoninovibhāvā amṛtāsuḥ sujanmā vardhamānaḥ | adabdhāsur bhrājamāno 'heva trito dādhāra trīṇi ||
6.2.d: ऋधङ्मन्द्रयोनिनोविभावा अमृतासुः सुजन्मा वर्धमानः । अदब्धासुर् भ्राजमानो ऽहेव त्रितो दाधार त्रीणि ॥
6.2.m: Possessing immortal life, well-born, growing, / with unbeguiled life, shining like the day, / Trita has upheld the three.

6.2.s: ni yo dharmaṇi prathamaḥ sasāda ato vapūṃṣi kṛṇute purūṇi | dhāsyur yoniṃ prathama ā viveśa ā yo vācam anuditāṃ cikāya ||
6.2.d: नि यो धर्मणि प्रथमः ससाद अतो वपूंषि कृणुते पुरूणि । धास्युर् योनिं प्रथम आ विवेश आ यो वाचम् अनुदितां चिकाय ॥
6.2.m: He who first [was set] in the law, / from that makes many beautiful forms; / desiring to nurse, he first entered the womb, / he who perceived the unspoken speech.

6.2.s: yas te śokas tanva ārireca kṣarad dhiraṇyaṃ śucayo 'nu svāḥ | atrā dadhiṣe amṛtāni nāma asme vastrāṇīṣa erayanta ||
6.2.d: यस् ते शोकस् तन्व आरिरेच क्षरद् धिरण्यं शुचयो ऽनु स्वाः । अत्रा दधिषे अमृतानि नाम अस्मे वस्त्राणीष एरयन्त ॥
6.2.m: The heat of yours that was left over from the body, / gold along with its own [forms], / here you have assumed immortal names; / to us they have sent garments and refreshments.

6.2.s: pra yad ete prataraṃ pūrvyaṃ guḥ sadaḥsada ātiṣṭhanto ajuryam | kaviḥ śuṣasya mātarā rihāṇe jāmirvadhuryuḥpratimānimīta ||
6.2.d: प्र यद् एते प्रतरं पूर्व्यं गुः सदःसद आतिष्ठन्तो अजुर्यम् । कविः शुषस्य मातरा रिहाणे जामिर्वधुर्युःप्रतिमानिमीत ॥
6.2.m: When these went further to the ancient [seat], / mounting each seat, / the poet licking the two mothers of the blast […]

6.2.s: tad ū ṣu te mahā pṛthuryaman namaḥ kaviḥ kāvyenākṛṇot | yat samyañco 'bhiyanto 'dhi kṣām adhā mahī rodhacakrā vavardha ||
6.2.d: तद् ऊ षु ते महा पृथुर्यमन् नमः कविः काव्येनाकृणोत् । यत् सम्यञ्चो ऽभियन्तो ऽधि क्षाम् अधा मही रोधचक्रा ववर्ध ॥
6.2.m: Well indeed has the poet with poetic skill made / that great homage for you, / when going together toward [it], / then the great one of restraining wheels has grown.

6.2.s: sapta maryādāḥ kavayas tatakṣus tāsām id ekām abhy aṃhuro gāt | utāmṛtāsur vṛta eṣi kṛṇvann asura āptaḥ svadhayā samadguḥ ||
6.2.d: सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस् ततक्षुस् तासाम् इद् एकाम् अभ्य् अंहुरो गात् । उतामृतासुर् वृत एषि कृण्वन्न् असुर आप्तः स्वधया समद्गुः ॥
6.2.m: The poets fashioned seven boundaries; / toward one of them went the narrow one. / And possessing immortal life you go, choosing, making; / the Asura, reached by his own nature, [is] swift-moving.

6.2.s: utāyur jyeṣṭho ratnā dadhāty ūrjā vā yaṃ sacate kavir dāḥ | putro vā yat pitarā kṣatram īrte jyeṣṭhaṃ maryādam ahvayan svasti ||
6.2.d: उतायुर् ज्येष्ठो रत्ना दधात्य् ऊर्जा वा यं सचते कविर् दाः । पुत्रो वा यत् पितरा क्षत्रम् ईर्ते ज्येष्ठं मर्यादम् अह्वयन् स्वस्ति ॥
6.2.m: And the eldest life-span establishes treasures, / or the poet gives what he pursues with vigor. / Or when the son sets in motion the two parents, the dominion, / they called the eldest boundary well-being.

6.2.s: darśan nu tān varuṇa ye ta iṣṭāv āvarvṛtataḥ kṛṇavo vapūṃṣi | ardham ardhena śavasā pṛṇakṣy ardhena śuṣmaṃ vardhase 'mūra ||
6.2.d: दर्शन् नु तान् वरुण ये त इष्टाव् आवर्वृततः कृणवो वपूंषि । अर्धम् अर्धेन शवसा पृणक्ष्य् अर्धेन शुष्मं वर्धसे ऽमूर ॥
6.2.m: May they see those, O Varuṇa, who in your sacrifice / turn about, [for whom] you will make forms. / With one half you combine with strength; / with the other half you grow in fury, O wise one.

6.2.s: avīvṛdhāma śagmyaṃ sakhāyaṃ varuṇaṃ putram aditer iṣiram | kaviśastāny asmai vacāṃsy avocāma rodasī satyavācau ||
6.2.d: अवीवृधाम शग्म्यं सखायं वरुणं पुत्रम् अदितेर् इषिरम् । कविशस्तान्य् अस्मै वचांस्य् अवोचाम रोदसी सत्यवाचौ ॥
6.2.m: We have magnified the capable friend, / Varuṇa, the active son of Aditi. / We have spoken words praised by the poet to him / and to the two world-halves of true speech.

6.3.s: ko vaḥ paścāt prāvicchāyat kaḥ puraḥ prākhanat pathaḥ | yadaita tvaramāṇā varuṇaprasūtā āpaḥ ||
6.3.d: को वः पश्चात् प्राविच्छायत् कः पुरः प्राखनत् पथः । यदैत त्वरमाणा वरुणप्रसूता आपः ॥
6.3.m: Who caused you to stream from behind? / Who dug out the paths in front, / when you went hastening, / O waters impelled by Varuṇa?

6.3.s: prajāpatir asṛjata sa puraḥ prākhanat pathaḥ | sa u no anv avāsṛjat tena sṛṣṭāḥ kṣarāmasi ||
6.3.d: प्रजापतिर् असृजत स पुरः प्राखनत् पथः । स उ नो अन्व् अवासृजत् तेन सृष्टाः क्षरामसि ॥
6.3.m: Prajāpati created [us]; / he dug out the paths in front. / And he released us; / created by him, we flow.

6.3.s: punānā āpo bahudhā sravanti imāṃś ca lokān pradiśaś ca sarvāḥ | punantv asmān duritād avadyān muñcantu mṛtyor nirṛter upasthāt ||
6.3.d: पुनाना आपो बहुधा स्रवन्ति इमांश् च लोकान् प्रदिशश् च सर्वाः । पुनन्त्व् अस्मान् दुरिताद् अवद्यान् मुञ्चन्तु मृत्योर् निरृतेर् उपस्थात् ॥
6.3.m: Purifying themselves, the waters flow in many ways / to these worlds and to all the intermediate quarters. / May they purify us from misfortune, from blame; / may they release [us] from death, from the lap of Nirṛti.

6.3.s: āpo asmān mātaraḥ sūdayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapuvaḥ punantu | viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīr ud id ābhyaḥ śucir ā pūta emi ||
6.3.d: आपो अस्मान् मातरः सूदयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतपुवः पुनन्तु । विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीर् उद् इद् आभ्यः शुचिर् आ पूत एमि ॥
6.3.m: May the waters, the mothers, refresh us; / may they, purifying with ghee, purify us with ghee. / For the divine ones carry away all defilement; / I come forth from them clear and purified.

6.3.s: āpo devīr mātaraḥ sūdayiṣṇavo ghṛtaścuto madhunā saṃ papṛcre | tā asmabhyaṃ sūrayo viśvam āyuḥ kṣapa usrā varivasyantu śubhrāḥ ||
6.3.d: आपो देवीर् मातरः सूदयिष्णवो घृतश्चुतो मधुना सं पपृच्रे । ता अस्मभ्यं सूरयो विश्वम् आयुः क्षप उस्रा वरिवस्यन्तु शुभ्राः ॥
6.3.m: May the divine waters, the mothers, refreshing, / dripping with ghee, [mixed] with honey, / shining patrons, grant us full lifespan, / night and morning, bright ones.

6.3.s: udakasyodakatamā revattamā revatīnām | śundhantām āpaḥ śundhantv asmān ||
6.3.d: उदकस्योदकतमा रेवत्तमा रेवतीनाम् । शुन्धन्ताम् आपः शुन्धन्त्व् अस्मान् ॥
6.3.m: Most watery of water, / most opulent of the opulent, / may the waters / cleanse us.

6.3.s: yūyam āpo vīraśriyo yūyaṃ sūdayathā śucīn | yuṣmākam id diśo mahīr īyante pradiśaḥ pṛthak ||
6.3.d: यूयम् आपो वीरश्रियो यूयं सूदयथा शुचीन् । युष्माकम् इद् दिशो महीर् ईयन्ते प्रदिशः पृथक् ॥
6.3.m: You waters bring splendor to heroes; / you refresh the pure. / Indeed to your greatness go the quarters / and the intermediate quarters separately.

6.3.s: yūyaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya yonir yūyaṃ somasya dhenavo madhiṣṭhāḥ | yuṣmān devīr deva ā kṣiyatīndur yūyaṃ jinvata brahmakṣatram āpaḥ ||
6.3.d: यूयं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य योनिर् यूयं सोमस्य धेनवो मधिष्ठाः । युष्मान् देवीर् देव आ क्षियतीन्दुर् यूयं जिन्वत ब्रह्मक्षत्रम् आपः ॥
6.3.m: You are the womb of Mitra and Varuṇa; / you are the milch-cows of Soma, sweetest. / Among you, divine ones, the divine drop dwells; / do you invigorate the priesthood and nobility, O waters.

6.3.s: śaśvad ābhiḥ śāśadānāḥ śamanānvayāmasi | āpo viśvasya sūdanīr yā devā manave dadhuḥ ||
6.3.d: शश्वद् आभिः शाशदानाः शमनान्वयामसि । आपो विश्वस्य सूदनीर् या देवा मनवे दधुः ॥
6.3.m: Ever prevailing with these, / […], / the waters, the refreshers of all, / which the gods established for Manu.

6.3.s: yad dhāvanti punate tad āpo yat tiṣṭhanti śuddhā it tad bhavanti | nāsām avadyam avidaṃ na ripraṃ sanād eva madhunā saṃ papṛcre ||
6.3.d: यद् धावन्ति पुनते तद् आपो यत् तिष्ठन्ति शुद्धा इत् तद् भवन्ति । नासाम् अवद्यम् अविदं न रिप्रं सनाद् एव मधुना सं पपृच्रे ॥
6.3.m: When the waters run, they cleanse; / when they stand, they become pure. / I have found neither fault nor defilement in them; / from of old they are united with sweetness.

6.3.s: hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ pra cakramur hitvāvadyam āpaḥ | śataṃ ca vaḥ prasravaṇeṣu devīḥ sahasraṃ ca pavitāraḥ punanti ||
6.3.d: हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावकाः प्र चक्रमुर् हित्वावद्यम् आपः । शतं च वः प्रस्रवणेषु देवीः सहस्रं च पवितारः पुनन्ति ॥
6.3.m: Golden-hued, pure, purifying, / the waters have stepped forth, leaving fault behind. / In your streams a hundred purifying deities / and a thousand cleanse [us].

6.3.s: tās tādṛśīr brahmāṇaṃ sūdayanty aṅgoṣṭhyā stotryā jīvadhanyāḥ | yā viśvasya śucikṛto ayātor gāva iva payasā sthā sujātāḥ ||
6.3.d: तास् तादृशीर् ब्रह्माणं सूदयन्त्य् अङ्गोष्ठ्या स्तोत्र्या जीवधन्याः । या विश्वस्य शुचिकृतो अयातोर् गाव इव पयसा स्था सुजाताः ॥
6.3.m: They refresh the priest, / possessing praise in song, rich in living. / You who are the purifiers of all that is free from torment, / like cows with milk you are well-born.

6.3.s: viśvād riprān muñcata sindhavo no yāny enāṃsi cakṛmā tanūbhiḥ | indrapraśiṣṭā varuṇaprasūtā ā siñcatāpo madhv ā samudre ||
6.3.d: विश्वाद् रिप्रान् मुञ्चत सिन्धवो नो यान्य् एनांसि चकृमा तनूभिः । इन्द्रप्रशिष्टा वरुणप्रसूता आ सिञ्चतापो मध्व् आ समुद्रे ॥
6.3.m: Release us, O rivers, from all defilement, / from whatever sins we have committed with our bodies. / Commanded by Indra, impelled by Varuṇa, / pour out sweetness into the sea, O waters.

6.4.s: rātrī mātā nabhaḥ pitā aryamā te pitāmahaḥ | śilācī nāma vā asi sā devānām asi svasā ||
6.4.d: रात्री माता नभः पिता अर्यमा ते पितामहः । शिलाची नाम वा असि सा देवानाम् असि स्वसा ॥
6.4.m: Night is your mother, the sky your father, / Aryaman is your grandfather. / Your name is Śilācī; / you are the sister of the gods.

6.4.s: yas tvā pibati jīvati trāyase puruṣaṃ tvam | dhartrī ca śaśvatām asi śaśvatāṃ ca nyañcanī ||
6.4.d: यस् त्वा पिबति जीवति त्रायसे पुरुषं त्वम् । धर्त्री च शश्वताम् असि शश्वतां च न्यञ्चनी ॥
6.4.m: Whoever drinks you lives; / you protect man. / You are the supporter of all / and the refuge of all.

6.4.s: yad daṇḍena yad iṣvā yad arur harasā kṛtam | tasya tvam asi bheṣajī niṣkṛtir nāma vā asi ||
6.4.d: यद् दण्डेन यद् इष्वा यद् अरुर् हरसा कृतम् । तस्य त्वम् असि भेषजी निष्कृतिर् नाम वा असि ॥
6.4.m: What is done by a stick, what by an arrow, / what wound is made by heat, / of that you are the remedy; / your name is Restorer.

6.4.s: bhadrā plakṣe ni tiṣṭhasy aśvatthe khadire dhave | bhadrā nyagrodhe parṇe sā na ehy arundhati ||
6.4.d: भद्रा प्लक्षे नि तिष्ठस्य् अश्वत्थे खदिरे धवे । भद्रा न्यग्रोधे पर्णे सा न एह्य् अरुन्धति ॥
6.4.m: Auspicious, you stand in the plakṣa, / in the aśvattha, the khadira, the dhava; / auspicious in the nyagrodha, in the parṇa; / as such come to us, O Arundhatī.

6.4.s: vṛkṣaṃvṛkṣam ā rohasi vṛṣaṇyantīva kanyalā | jayantī pratyātiṣṭhantī saṃjayā nāma vā asi ||
6.4.d: वृक्षंवृक्षम् आ रोहसि वृषण्यन्तीव कन्यला । जयन्ती प्रत्यातिष्ठन्ती संजया नाम वा असि ॥
6.4.m: You climb tree after tree / like a girl longing for a bull; / conquering, standing firm, / your name is All-conquering.

6.4.s: hiraṇyavarṇe yuvate śuṣme lomaśavakṣaṇe | apām asi svasā lākṣe vāto hātmā babhūva te ||
6.4.d: हिरण्यवर्णे युवते शुष्मे लोमशवक्षणे । अपाम् असि स्वसा लाक्षे वातो हात्मा बभूव ते ॥
6.4.m: Golden-hued, youthful, / fiery, hairy-bellied, / you are the sister of the waters, O lac; / the wind was your soul.

6.4.s: hiraṇyabāho subhage sūryavarṇe vapuṣṭame | rutaṃ gacchati niṣkṛtiḥ semaṃ niṣkṛdhi pūruṣam ||
6.4.d: हिरण्यबाहो सुभगे सूर्यवर्णे वपुष्टमे । रुतं गच्छति निष्कृतिः सेमं निष्कृधि पूरुषम् ॥
6.4.m: Golden-armed, fortunate, / sun-colored, most wonderful, / the remedy goes to the wound; / restore this man!

6.4.s: ghṛtācī nāma kānīno 'jababhru pitā tava | aśvo yamasya yaḥ śyāvas tasya hāsnāsy ukṣitā ||
6.4.d: घृताची नाम कानीनो ऽजबभ्रु पिता तव । अश्वो यमस्य यः श्यावस् तस्य हास्नास्य् उक्षिता ॥
6.4.m: The maiden is named Ghṛtācī; / goat-brown is your father. / The dark horse that belongs to Yama, / his blood you are.

6.4.s: aśvasyāsnaḥ saṃpatitā sā parṇam abhi ṣiṣyadaḥ | sarā patatriṇy asi sā na ehy arundhati ||
6.4.d: अश्वस्यास्नः संपतिता सा पर्णम् अभि षिष्यदः । सरा पतत्रिण्य् असि सा न एह्य् अरुन्धति ॥
6.4.m: Fallen together, / you flowed down onto the leaf. / You are gliding, winged; / as such come to us, O Arundhatī.

6.4.s: ghṛtācike vātarathe vidyutparṇe arundhati | āturaṃ gamiṣṭhāsi tvam aṅga niṣkarīyasī ||
6.4.d: घृताचिके वातरथे विद्युत्पर्णे अरुन्धति । आतुरं गमिष्ठासि त्वम् अङ्ग निष्करीयसी ॥
6.4.m: O little Ghṛtācī, / lightning-winged Arundhatī, / you go most swiftly to the sick; / you are truly most restoring.

6.4.s: yat te jagdhaṃ piśācais tat ta ā pyāyatāṃ punaḥ | lākṣā tvā viśvabheṣajī devebhis trāyatāṃ saha ||
6.4.d: यत् ते जग्धं पिशाचैस् तत् त आ प्यायतां पुनः । लाक्षा त्वा विश्वभेषजी देवेभिस् त्रायतां सह ॥
6.4.m: What of you has been eaten by the Piśācas, / let that swell up again for you. / Let lac, the all-healing, / protect you together with the gods.

6.5.s: yathā dyauś ca pṛthivī ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibher evā me 'pāna mā riṣaḥ ||
6.5.d: यथा द्यौश् च पृथिवी च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेर् एवा मे ऽपान मा रिषः ॥
6.5.m: Just as both heaven and earth / do not fear and are not harmed, / so, my in-breath, do not fear; / so, my out-breath, do not be harmed.
Just as both the wind and the atmosphere […]
Just as both the sun and the moon […]
Just as both the milch-cow and the draft-ox […]
Just as both Mitra and Varuṇa […]
Just as both priesthood and nobility […]
Just as Indra and Indra's power […]
Just as the hero and heroism […]

6.5.s: yathā bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibher evā me 'pāna mā riṣaḥ ||
6.5.d: यथा भूतं च भव्यं च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेर् एवा मे ऽपान मा रिषः ॥
6.5.m: Just as both what has been and what is to be / do not fear and are not harmed, / so, my in-breath, do not fear; / so, my out-breath, do not be harmed.

6.6.s: madhuman me nikramaṇaṃ madhuman me parāyaṇam | vācā madhumad udyāsam akṣyau me madhusaṃdṛśī ||
6.6.d: मधुमन् मे निक्रमणं मधुमन् मे परायणम् । वाचा मधुमद् उद्यासम् अक्ष्यौ मे मधुसंदृशी ॥
6.6.m: Honey-sweet be my stepping out, / honey-sweet my departure; / with my voice may I speak honey-sweet words; / may my eyes be sweet to look upon.

6.6.s: mām anu prasārayan mama patto nipedivān | atho me punar āyato akṣyau kāmena śuṣyatām ||
6.6.d: माम् अनु प्रसारयन् मम पत्तो निपेदिवान् । अथो मे पुनर् आयतो अक्ष्यौ कामेन शुष्यताम् ॥
6.6.m: Extending along after me, / sitting down at my feet, / and when I return, / may their eyes dry up with desire [for me].

6.6.s: vaśā madhugha te mātā ukṣā bhrātarṣabhaḥ pitā | dhenvā adhi prajāto 'si rājā san madhumattamaḥ ||
6.6.d: वशा मधुघ ते माता उक्षा भ्रातर्षभः पिता । धेन्वा अधि प्रजातो ऽसि राजा सन् मधुमत्तमः ॥
6.6.m: A barren cow is your mother, O honey-plant; / an ox is your brother, a bull your father. / You are born from a milch-cow, / being a king, sweetest with honey.

6.6.s: vṛṣāṇaṃ vṛṣṇyāvantaṃ somapṛṣṭhaṃ divi śritam | indrāṇy agra ābharan madhughaṃ bhagāya kam ||
6.6.d: वृषाणं वृष्ण्यावन्तं सोमपृष्ठं दिवि श्रितम् । इन्द्राण्य् अग्र आभरन् मधुघं भगाय कम् ॥
6.6.m: The bull, full of manly vigor, / having Soma on his back, dwelling in heaven— / Indrāṇī first brought the honey-plant / for good fortune.

6.6.s: pitubhojano madhughaḥ śauṣkāsyo hṛdayāya kam | sa mā madhunānaktu yathāhaṃ kāmaye tathā ||
6.6.d: पितुभोजनो मधुघः शौष्कास्यो हृदयाय कम् । स मा मधुनानक्तु यथाहं कामये तथा ॥
6.6.m: Enjoying food is the honey-plant, / with dry mouth, for the sake of the heart. / May it anoint me with honey, / just as I desire.

6.6.s: sindhuprajāno madhugho aśva iva nīyate janām̐ anu | sa mā … ||
6.6.d: सिन्धुप्रजानो मधुघो अश्व इव नीयते जनाँ अनु । स मा … ॥
6.6.m: Born from the river, the honey-plant / is led among people like a horse; / may it […] me […]

6.6.s: madhumatī sinīvālī madhunā mā sam ukṣatu | sā mā madhunānaktu yathāhaṃ kāmaye tathā ||
6.6.d: मधुमती सिनीवाली मधुना मा सम् उक्षतु । सा मा मधुनानक्तु यथाहं कामये तथा ॥
6.6.m: Full of honey, Sinīvālī, / let her sprinkle me with honey. / May she anoint me with honey, / just as I desire.

6.6.s: yathā madhu madhukṛto nyañjanti madhāv adhi | evā ny anajmi te mano adhy asyāṃ māmakī tanū ||
6.6.d: यथा मधु मधुकृतो न्यञ्जन्ति मधाव् अधि । एवा न्य् अनज्मि ते मनो अध्य् अस्यां मामकी तनू ॥
6.6.m: Just as the honey-makers / smear honey upon honey, / so I smear your mind / upon this [matter] of mine.

6.6.s: yat te manaḥ parāgataṃ yad baddham iha veha vā | tat ta ā vartayāmasi mayi badhnāmi te manaḥ ||
6.6.d: यत् ते मनः परागतं यद् बद्धम् इह वेह वा । तत् त आ वर्तयामसि मयि बध्नामि ते मनः ॥
6.6.m: Whatever mind of yours has gone away, / whatever is bound here or there, / that we turn back to you; / I bind your mind to myself.

6.7.s: kaśyapaś ca suparṇaś ca yan marīcyām atiṣṭhatām | suparṇaḥ pary avāpaśyat samudre bhūmim āvṛtām ||
6.7.d: कश्यपश् च सुपर्णश् च यन् मरीच्याम् अतिष्ठताम् । सुपर्णः पर्य् अवापश्यत् समुद्रे भूमिम् आवृताम् ॥
6.7.m: When Kaśyapa and Suparṇa / stood in the ray of light, / Suparṇa looked around / at the earth enveloped in the sea.

6.7.s: yāṃ suparṇaḥ paryapaśyad antar mahaty arṇave | tāṃ sūkara tvaṃ māyayā triḥ samudrād ud ābharaḥ ||
6.7.d: यां सुपर्णः पर्यपश्यद् अन्तर् महत्य् अर्णवे । तां सूकर त्वं मायया त्रिः समुद्राद् उद् आभरः ॥
6.7.m: Which [earth] Suparṇa looked around at / within the great surge, / that, O boar, with your magical power, / three times up from the sea […].

6.7.s: yaṃ samudrād udabharo bhūmiṃ sūkara māyayā | saiṣā viṣasya dūṣaṇy asmai bhavatu bheṣajī ||
6.7.d: यं समुद्राद् उदभरो भूमिं सूकर मायया । सैषा विषस्य दूषण्य् अस्मै भवतु भेषजी ॥
6.7.m: The earth which you brought up from the sea, / O boar, with your magical power, / let that very one, destroying poison, / become a medicine for this man.

6.7.s: acyutā hiraṇyena yā satye adhitiṣṭhati | tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare ||
6.7.d: अच्युता हिरण्येन या सत्ये अधितिष्ठति । तस्यास् ते विश्वधायसो विषदूषणम् उद् भरे ॥
6.7.m: Unshaken, with gold, / she who rests upon truth— / from you, all-nourishing, / I bring up the destroyer of poison.

6.7.s: yasyā bhūmyā upajīkā gṛhaṃ kṛṇvata ātmane | tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare ||
6.7.d: यस्या भूम्या उपजीका गृहं कृण्वत आत्मने । तस्यास् ते विश्वधायसो विषदूषणम् उद् भरे ॥
6.7.m: Of which earth the upajīkā ants / make a home for themselves, / from you, all-nourishing, / I bring up the destroyer of poison.

6.7.s: yas tvā bhūme 'nvavindad yas tvā bhūma udābharat | tayoḥ sahasradhāmann ahaṃ nāmāni jagrabha ||
6.7.d: यस् त्वा भूमे ऽन्वविन्दद् यस् त्वा भूम उदाभरत् । तयोः सहस्रधामन्न् अहं नामानि जग्रभ ॥
6.7.m: He who found you, O earth, / he who brought you up, O earth— / their names, O you of a thousand homes, / I have seized.

6.7.s: yāni ta indro akṛṇod bhūme nāmāni vṛtrahā | tāni te babhroḥ saṃ vidma sehaidhi viṣadūṣaṇī ||
6.7.d: यानि त इन्द्रो अकृणोद् भूमे नामानि वृत्रहा । तानि ते बभ्रोः सं विद्म सेहैधि विषदूषणी ॥
6.7.m: Whatever names Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, / made for you, O earth, / those names of yours, the brown one, we know; / as such, be here the destroyer of poison.

6.7.s: yāni te marutaś cakrur yāni saptarṣayo viduḥ | viśva ādityā yāṃ viduḥ sā bhūmir viṣadūṣaṇī ||
6.7.d: यानि ते मरुतश् चक्रुर् यानि सप्तर्षयो विदुः । विश्व आदित्या यां विदुः सा भूमिर् विषदूषणी ॥
6.7.m: Which [names] the Maruts made for you, / which the seven sages know, / which all the Ādityas know, / that earth is the destroyer of poison.

6.8.s: sahasva yātudhānān sahasva yātudhānyaḥ | sahasva sarvā rakṣāṃsi sahamānāsy oṣadhe ||
6.8.d: सहस्व यातुधानान् सहस्व यातुधान्यः । सहस्व सर्वा रक्षांसि सहमानास्य् ओषधे ॥
6.8.m: Overcome the sorcerers, / overcome the sorceresses, / overcome all the demons; / you are the overcoming herb.

6.8.s: sahamāne sahasvati sahanty ahamuttare | utāham asmi sāsahiḥ sāsahe vaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
6.8.d: सहमाने सहस्वति सहन्त्य् अहमुत्तरे । उताहम् अस्मि सासहिः सासहे वः सदान्वाः ॥
6.8.m: O overcoming one, full of might, / conquering, superior, / I too am victorious; / I have overcome you, O Sadānvās.

6.8.s: yā sahamānā carasi sāsahāna ivarṣabhaḥ | sadānvāghnī rakṣoghnī sā tvam ugrāsy oṣadhe ||
6.8.d: या सहमाना चरसि सासहान इवर्षभः । सदान्वाघ्नी रक्षोघ्नी सा त्वम् उग्रास्य् ओषधे ॥
6.8.m: You who go about overcoming / like a conquering bull, / slayer of the Sadānvās, slayer of demons, / as such you are fierce, O herb.

6.8.s: khele hai lambanastani naśyetaḥ prāmutaḥ pata | na tvām avivyacad iha ukṣeva śṛṅgavac chiraḥ ||
6.8.d: खेले है लम्बनस्तनि नश्येतः प्रामुतः पत । न त्वाम् अविव्यचद् इह उक्षेव शृङ्गवच् छिरः ॥
6.8.m: O limping one, O pendulous-breasted one, / perish from here, fly away yonder! / Not to you here […] / like an ox with a horned head.

6.8.s: asuvāne bahuputre anantarve mahodari | pathāsmat satvare tvaṃ śarkarā bapsatī cara ||
6.8.d: असुवाने बहुपुत्रे अनन्तर्वे महोदरि । पथास्मत् सत्वरे त्वं शर्करा बप्सती चर ॥
6.8.m: Giving birth without labor, having many children, / not pregnant, big-bellied, / go quickly away from us by the path, / chewing gravel.

6.8.s: ye 'rāyāś caratha pākasyecchanta āsutim | tān agne kṛṣṇavartane tīkṣṇaśṛṅgodṛṣann ihi ||
6.8.d: ये ऽरायाश् चरथ पाकस्येच्छन्त आसुतिम् । तान् अग्ने कृष्णवर्तने तीक्ष्णशृङ्गोदृषन्न् इहि ॥
6.8.m: Whatever Grudgebearers go about, / desiring the pouring of the sacrificial food, / pierce them, O Agni of the black track, / goring them with your sharp horns.

6.8.s: ado yad dāru plavate sindhor madhye apūruṣam | tad ā rabhasva durhaṇo tena yāhi parastaram ||
6.8.d: अदो यद् दारु प्लवते सिन्धोर् मध्ये अपूरुषम् । तद् आ रभस्व दुर्हणो तेन याहि परस्तरम् ॥
6.8.m: Yonder log that floats / in the middle of the river, unmanned— / seize that, O ill-slain one; / go further away with it.

6.8.s: yasyā janitram iṣṭargā adṛṣṭāḥ krimayaḥ pluṣayaḥ | tasyai balāsapatnyai namas kṛṇomi kuṣṭhyai ||
6.8.d: यस्या जनित्रम् इष्टर्गा अदृष्टाः क्रिमयः प्लुषयः । तस्यै बलासपत्न्यै नमस् कृणोमि कुष्ठ्यै ॥
6.8.m: Whose place of origin is the iṣṭargā, / the unseen worms, / to her, the rival of the balāsa, / to the kuṣṭha-plant I pay homage.

6.8.s: śarvaputre bhavapatni yātubhrātri sadānve | tasyāddhi putrān bhrātṝṃś ca yatra tvā vinayāmasi ||
6.8.d: शर्वपुत्रे भवपत्नि यातुभ्रात्रि सदान्वे । तस्याद्धि पुत्रान् भ्रातॄंश् च यत्र त्वा विनयामसि ॥
6.8.m: O daughter of Śarva, wife of Bhava, / sister of sorcerers, O Sadānvā, / eat her sons and brothers / to wherever we lead you away.

6.9.s: vṛṣāyam aṃśur vṛṣabhāya gṛhyate vṛṣāyam ugro nṛcakṣase | divyo naryo 'cikradan mahan nāmarṣabhasya yat kakut ||
6.9.d: वृषायम् अंशुर् वृषभाय गृह्यते वृषायम् उग्रो नृचक्षसे । दिव्यो नर्यो ऽचिक्रदन् महन् नामर्षभस्य यत् ककुत् ॥
6.9.m: This bull-like stalk is drawn for the bull; / this bull-like, fierce one for the watcher of men. / The heavenly, manly one has roared, / which great name is the hump of the bull.

6.9.s: viṣuvān viṣṇo bhava tvaṃ yo nṛpatir mama | atho indra iva devebhyo vi bravītu janebhyaḥ ||
6.9.d: विषुवान् विष्णो भव त्वं यो नृपतिर् मम । अथो इन्द्र इव देवेभ्यो वि ब्रवीतु जनेभ्यः ॥
6.9.m: Be the central point, O Viṣṇu, / you who are my lord of men. / Also, like Indra to the gods, / let him speak out to the people.

6.9.s: manuṣyebhyo vi bravītu sajūr indreṇa medinā | agniś ca tubhyaṃ sāhantyo rāṣṭraṃ vaiśvānaro dadhat ||
6.9.d: मनुष्येभ्यो वि ब्रवीतु सजूर् इन्द्रेण मेदिना । अग्निश् च तुभ्यं साहन्त्यो राष्ट्रं वैश्वानरो दधत् ॥
6.9.m: Let him speak out to men, / allied with Indra as his partner; / and let Agni Vaiśvānara, victorious, / bestow the realm upon you.

6.9.s: yasyāyaṃ bhāga ṛṣabha indrāya pariṇīyate | sa hantu śatrūn āyato atho hantu parāyataḥ ||
6.9.d: यस्यायं भाग ऋषभ इन्द्राय परिणीयते । स हन्तु शत्रून् आयतो अथो हन्तु परायतः ॥
6.9.m: He whose share this bull is, / led around for Indra, / let him strike enemies coming forward, / and let him strike those departing.

6.9.s: sa hantā śatror bhavatu hantā bhavatu dodhatām | viśām aha praṇīr ayad agram udbhindatām asat ||
6.9.d: स हन्ता शत्रोर् भवतु हन्ता भवतु दोधताम् । विशाम् अह प्रणीर् अयद् अग्रम् उद्भिन्दताम् असत् ॥
6.9.m: Let him be a slayer of the enemy; / let him be a slayer of the raging. / May he walk as leader of the clans; / may he be at the head of those breaking through.

6.9.s: āyuṣmantaṃ varcasvantam atho adhipatiṃ viśām | asyāḥ pṛthivyāś cettāram imam indrarṣabhaṃ kṛṇu ||
6.9.d: आयुष्मन्तं वर्चस्वन्तम् अथो अधिपतिं विशाम् । अस्याः पृथिव्याश् चेत्तारम् इमम् इन्द्रर्षभं कृणु ॥
6.9.m: Long-lived, full of splendor, / and supreme lord of the clans, / perceiver of this earth, / make him into a bull, O Indra!

6.9.s: yaḥ suśṛṅgaḥ sukakudaḥ kalyāṇo barhir āsadat | kārṣīvaṇaprajānena ṛṣabheṇa yajāmahe ||
6.9.d: यः सुशृङ्गः सुककुदः कल्याणो बर्हिर् आसदत् । कार्षीवणप्रजानेन ऋषभेण यजामहे ॥
6.9.m: He who has fair horns and a fair hump, / auspicious, has sat down upon the barhis. / With the bull of agricultural breeding / we sacrifice.

6.9.s: ṛṣabheṇa yajamānā akrūreṇeva sarpiṣā | mṛdhaś ca sarvā indreṇa pṛtanāś ca sahāmahe ||
6.9.d: ऋषभेण यजमाना अक्रूरेणेव सर्पिषा । मृधश् च सर्वा इन्द्रेण पृतनाश् च सहामहे ॥
6.9.m: Sacrificing with the bull, / as with uninjurious melted butter, / we overcome all hostilities / and battles with Indra.

6.9.s: yaṃ tubhyaṃ bhāgam ṛṣabhaṃ devāḥ kevalyaṃ daduḥ | tena vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaḥ śatrūṃś ca jahy āhave ||
6.9.d: यं तुभ्यं भागम् ऋषभं देवाः केवल्यं ददुः । तेन वृत्राणि जङ्घनः शत्रूंश् च जह्य् आहवे ॥
6.9.m: The bull that the gods gave you / as your exclusive portion, / with it strike down obstacles / and kill enemies in battle.

6.9.s: jahi śatrūn vi mṛdho nudasva kṛṣyāḥ saṃbhūto asi vīryāvān | indrāya bhāgaṃ pari tvā nayāma urur no loko apṛtanyo astu ||
6.9.d: जहि शत्रून् वि मृधो नुदस्व कृष्याः संभूतो असि वीर्यावान् । इन्द्राय भागं परि त्वा नयाम उरुर् नो लोको अपृतन्यो अस्तु ॥
6.9.m: Slay enemies, drive away hostilities! / Sprung from agriculture, you are full of vigor. / We lead you around as a portion for Indra; / broad and free from conflict be our space.

6.9.s: ghṛtavṛddha ghṛtāhuta sahasraśṛṅga suṣṭuta | ghṛtāhavana dīdihi ||
6.9.d: घृतवृद्ध घृताहुत सहस्रशृङ्ग सुष्टुत । घृताहवन दीदिहि ॥
6.9.m: Grown through ghee, offered with ghee, / thousand-horned, well-praised, / you who receive offerings of ghee, shine forth!

6.9.s: yo ghṛtenābhighārita ugro jaitrāya tiṣṭhasi | sa naḥ saṅkāsu pāraya pṛtanāsāhyeṣu ca ||
6.9.d: यो घृतेनाभिघारित उग्रो जैत्राय तिष्ठसि । स नः सङ्कासु पारय पृतनासाह्येषु च ॥
6.9.m: You who, anointed with ghee, / stand fierce for victory, / carry us across / in victorious battles.

6.10.s: karkī subhāga ṛṣabhasya patnī prajākāmā vaśinī vāśitā gauḥ | tāṃ sahasram ekamukhā dadāti garbhaṃ dadhānām ṛtunā carantīm ||
6.10.d: कर्की सुभाग ऋषभस्य पत्नी प्रजाकामा वशिनी वाशिता गौः । तां सहस्रम् एकमुखा ददाति गर्भं दधानाम् ऋतुना चरन्तीम् ॥
6.10.m: White-spotted, fortunate, wife of the bull, / desiring offspring, sovereign, lowing cow: / she gives a thousand, one-mouthed, / bearing a calf, moving in due season.

6.10.s: garbhaṃ dadhānā paya id duhānā agnihotraṃ vaiśvadevī duhānā | gaur ṇo mā hiṃsīd varuṇasya patnī ||
6.10.d: गर्भं दधाना पय इद् दुहाना अग्निहोत्रं वैश्वदेवी दुहाना । गौर् णो मा हिंसीद् वरुणस्य पत्नी ॥
6.10.m: Bearing a calf, yielding milk, / yielding the Agnihotra, dedicated to all the gods, / may the cow, wife of Varuṇa, not harm us.

6.10.s: karkyā yoniṃ saṃmanaso 'bhi gāvaḥ prajāṃ dhitsanto vṛṣaṇaś caranti | sā na aitv aditir viśvarūpā abhi krandanti bhuvanāny enām ||
6.10.d: कर्क्या योनिं संमनसो ऽभि गावः प्रजां धित्सन्तो वृषणश् चरन्ति । सा न ऐत्व् अदितिर् विश्वरूपा अभि क्रन्दन्ति भुवनान्य् एनाम् ॥
6.10.m: Like-minded, the bulls wander toward / the womb of the white-spotted cow, seeking to place offspring. / Let her come to us, Aditi of all forms; / all creatures cry out to her.

6.10.s: prajāpatineṣitām ṛtviyāvatīm aināṃ prajāyā ṛṣabhāḥ śrayante | vṛṣaṇyantīṃ vṛṣaṇaḥ saptanāmnīṃ hiṃkṛṇvanto abhi nudantu vāśitām ||
6.10.d: प्रजापतिनेषिताम् ऋत्वियावतीम् ऐनां प्रजाया ऋषभाः श्रयन्ते । वृषण्यन्तीं वृषणः सप्तनाम्नीं हिंकृण्वन्तो अभि नुदन्तु वाशिताम् ॥
6.10.m: Impelled by Prajāpati, in her season, / the bulls mount her for offspring. / Desiring the male, having seven names, / lowing, let the bulls urge her on making the hiṃ-sound.

6.10.s: sā praty adarśy uṣasā suvarṇā śukrāṃ vasānā varuṇasya nirṇijam | vaiśvadevī svadhām ābharantī prajāṃ dātā puṣyatu gopatiṣ ṭe ||
6.10.d: सा प्रत्य् अदर्श्य् उषसा सुवर्णा शुक्रां वसाना वरुणस्य निर्णिजम् । वैश्वदेवी स्वधाम् आभरन्ती प्रजां दाता पुष्यतु गोपतिष् टे ॥
6.10.m: Facing the dawns, fair-colored, / clothed in Varuṇa's [splendor], / dedicated to all the gods, bringing her own portion, / may your giver, the cow-lord, thrive in offspring.

6.10.s: svayaṃsthāvary ṛṣabhāya tiṣṭhasi pratīcī somaṃ prati sūryam agnim | ahiṃsantī vāśite mām upehi paśūn dātā puṣyatu gopatiṣ ṭe ||
6.10.d: स्वयंस्थावर्य् ऋषभाय तिष्ठसि प्रतीची सोमं प्रति सूर्यम् अग्निम् । अहिंसन्ती वाशिते माम् उपेहि पशून् दाता पुष्यतु गोपतिष् टे ॥
6.10.m: Standing of your own accord, you stand for the bull, / facing Soma, facing the sun, facing Agni. / Unharming, O lowing cow, come to me; / may your giver, the cow-lord, thrive in cattle.

6.10.s: vaśī dātā bhavatu vāśitāyā agner bhāgam usriyāṃ yo dadāti | priyaṃ dhāma hṛdayaṃ somyaṃ madhu vājinīṃ tvā vājino vājayantu ||
6.10.d: वशी दाता भवतु वाशिताया अग्नेर् भागम् उस्रियां यो ददाति । प्रियं धाम हृदयं सोम्यं मधु वाजिनीं त्वा वाजिनो वाजयन्तु ॥
6.10.m: May the giver of the lowing cow be master, / he who gives the ruddy cow as Agni's share. / A dear abode, a heart, soma-like honey: / let the prize-winners invigorate you, the prize-bearing one.

6.10.s: yo vāśitāyāṃ gavy antar agnir yad asyāṃ nṛmṇaṃ mahimā babhūva | namas tasmai pratigṛhṇan kṛṇomi syonā me astu tanve suśevā ||
6.10.d: यो वाशितायां गव्य् अन्तर् अग्निर् यद् अस्यां नृम्णं महिमा बभूव । नमस् तस्मै प्रतिगृह्णन् कृणोमि स्योना मे अस्तु तन्वे सुशेवा ॥
6.10.m: The fire that is within the lowing cow, / whatever manliness and greatness has been in her, / paying homage to it as I receive [her], / let her be gentle and very kind to my body.

6.10.s: eyam agan vāśitā tāṃ pratīmaḥ puṃsāṃ vrātena saha puṣṭyā gauḥ | ūrjaṃ dadhānā ghṛtam id duhānā sahasrapoṣāya me astu dātre ||
6.10.d: एयम् अगन् वाशिता तां प्रतीमः पुंसां व्रातेन सह पुष्ट्या गौः । ऊर्जं दधाना घृतम् इद् दुहाना सहस्रपोषाय मे अस्तु दात्रे ॥
6.10.m: Here has come the lowing cow; we receive her, / the cow accompanied by a troop of males, with prosperity. / Bearing strength, yielding ghee, / may she be mine, the giver, for thousandfold thriving.

6.11.s: anāptā ye vaḥ prathamā yāni karmāṇi cakrire | vīrān no atra mā dabhan tad va etat puro dadhe ||
6.11.d: अनाप्ता ये वः प्रथमा यानि कर्माणि चक्रिरे । वीरान् नो अत्र मा दभन् तद् व एतत् पुरो दधे ॥
6.11.m: Those first [deeds] of yours which were not reached, / which actions they performed— / let them not harm our heroes here; / this [hymn] of yours I set before [us].

6.11.s: pratnān mānāt pari ye saṃbabhūvuḥ ślokavantaḥ saumanasasya vantavaḥ | apānakṣāso badhirā ahāsata ṛtasya panthāṃ na taranti duṣkṛtaḥ ||
6.11.d: प्रत्नान् मानात् परि ये संबभूवुः श्लोकवन्तः सौमनसस्य वन्तवः । अपानक्षासो बधिरा अहासत ऋतस्य पन्थां न तरन्ति दुष्कृतः ॥
6.11.m: Those who arose around the ancient measure, / possessors of praise, recipients of benevolence: / those who were blind and deaf have fallen away; / evil-doers do not cross the path of truth.

6.11.s: sahasradhāram abhi te sam asvaran divo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ | tasya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ padepade pāśinaḥ santu setave ||
6.11.d: सहस्रधारम् अभि ते सम् अस्वरन् दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः । तस्य स्पशो न नि मिषन्ति भूर्णयः पदेपदे पाशिनः सन्तु सेतवे ॥
6.11.m: Toward the thousand-streamed one they resounded together, / on the vault of heaven, sweet-tongued, never drying up. / His active spies do not blink; / let them be noose-bearers at every step, for a barrier.

6.11.s: pary ū ṣu pra dhanvā vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ | divas tad arṇavām̐ anv īyase sanisraso nāmāsi trayodaśo māsaḥ ||
6.11.d: पर्य् ऊ षु प्र धन्वा वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः । दिवस् तद् अर्णवाँ अन्व् ईयसे सनिस्रसो नामासि त्रयोदशो मासः ॥
6.11.m: Flow forth well around for the winning of prizes, / conquering obstacles all around! / You speed through those floods of heaven; / your name is the Thirteenth Month, the Tottering One.

6.11.s: indrasya gṛho 'sīndrasya śarmāsīndrasya varmāsīndrasya varūtham asi | vy etenāvaitenāpaitenārātsīr asau svāhā ||
6.11.d: इन्द्रस्य गृहो ऽसीन्द्रस्य शर्मासीन्द्रस्य वर्मासीन्द्रस्य वरूथम् असि । व्य् एतेनावैतेनापैतेनारात्सीर् असौ स्वाहा ॥
6.11.m: You are Indra's house, you are Indra's shelter, you are Indra's armor, you are Indra's protection. / Go away by this, go down by this, go off by this! You have succeeded, so-and-so, svāhā!

6.11.s: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevāv agnīṣomāv iha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ | mumuktam asmān gṛbhītān avadyāj juṣethāṃ yajñam amṛtam asmāsu dhattaṃ svāhā ||
6.11.d: तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवाव् अग्नीषोमाव् इह सु मृडतं नः । मुमुक्तम् अस्मान् गृभीतान् अवद्याज् जुषेथां यज्ञम् अमृतम् अस्मासु धत्तं स्वाहा ॥
6.11.m: Sharp-weaponed, sharp-missiled, very kind, / O Agni and Soma, be very gracious to us here! / Release us from blame; / enjoy the sacrifice, place immortality in us, svāhā!

6.11.s: cakṣuṣo hete manaso hete brahmaṇo hete menyāmenir asi | amenayas te santu ye 'smān abhyaghāyanti svāhā ||
6.11.d: चक्षुषो हेते मनसो हेते ब्रह्मणो हेते मेन्यामेनिर् असि । अमेनयस् ते सन्तु ये ऽस्मान् अभ्यघायन्ति स्वाहा ॥
6.11.m: Missile of the eye, missile of the mind, missile of the sacred word, you are wrath upon wrath. / Let those who plot evil against us be without wrath, svāhā!

6.11.s: yo 'smāñ cakṣuṣā manasā yaś ca vācākūtyā cittyā brahmaṇāghāyur abhidāsāt | tam agne tvaṃ menyāmeniṃ kṛṇu svāhā ||
6.11.d: यो ऽस्माञ् चक्षुषा मनसा यश् च वाचाकूत्या चित्त्या ब्रह्मणाघायुर् अभिदासात् । तम् अग्ने त्वं मेन्यामेनिं कृणु स्वाहा ॥
6.11.m: Whoever with eye, with mind, / and who with speech, intention, thought, [or] sacred word plots evil and assails us, / O Agni, make him subject to wrath upon wrath, svāhā!

6.11.s: ud āyur ut kṛtam ud balam un manīṣod indriyaṃ nṛmṇam asmāsu dhehi svāhā ||
6.11.d: उद् आयुर् उत् कृतम् उद् बलम् उन् मनीषोद् इन्द्रियं नृम्णम् अस्मासु धेहि स्वाहा ॥
6.11.m: Upward life, upward action, upward strength, upward thought, upward power: / place manly vigor in us, svāhā!

6.12.s: āyuṣkṛtāyuṣmatī svadhāvantau gopā me stho gopāyataṃ mā | ātmasadau me staṃ tanve suśevau mā mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ svāhā ||
6.12.d: आयुष्कृतायुष्मती स्वधावन्तौ गोपा मे स्थो गोपायतं मा । आत्मसदौ मे स्तं तन्वे सुशेवौ मा मा हिंसिष्टं स्वाहा ॥
6.12.m: Makers of life, possessing life, possessing inherent power, / you two are my protectors; protect me! / Be dwellers in my self, very kind to my body; / do not harm me, svāhā!

6.12.s: indrasya gṛho 'sīndrasya śarmāsīndrasya varmāsīndrasya varūtham asi | taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvāṅgaḥ sarvātmā sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ saha yan me 'sti tena ||
6.12.d: इन्द्रस्य गृहो ऽसीन्द्रस्य शर्मासीन्द्रस्य वर्मासीन्द्रस्य वरूथम् असि । तं त्वा प्र विशामि सर्वाङ्गः सर्वात्मा सर्वगुः सर्वपूरुषः सह यन् मे ऽस्ति तेन ॥
6.12.m: You are Indra's house, you are Indra's shelter, you are Indra's armor, you are Indra's protection. / I enter you with all my limbs, all my self, all my cattle, all my men, together with whatever is mine.

6.12.s: astṛto nāmāham ayam asmi sa ātmānaṃ pari dadhe dyāvāpṛthivībhyām | gopīthāya pra hūyase ||
6.12.d: अस्तृतो नामाहम् अयम् अस्मि स आत्मानं परि दधे द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् । गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे ॥
6.12.m: Unvanquished by name am I here; / I entrust myself to heaven and earth. / You are called upon for protection.

6.12.s: astṛto nāma prājāpatyo devo māsas trayodaśaḥ | sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ prāgāṃ devapurā aham ||
6.12.d: अस्तृतो नाम प्राजापत्यो देवो मासस् त्रयोदशः । सर्वगुः सर्वपूरुषः प्रागां देवपुरा अहम् ॥
6.12.m: Unvanquished by name, son of Prajāpati, / the god, the thirteenth month; / with all my cattle, with all my men, / I have entered the divine fortresses.

6.12.s: antaḥ prāgāṃ devapurāḥ sahagrāmaḥ svastaye | saṃvatsarasya madhyataḥ sarvaiḥ sodaryaiḥ saha || prapāṭhaka ||
6.12.d: अन्तः प्रागां देवपुराः सहग्रामः स्वस्तये । संवत्सरस्य मध्यतः सर्वैः सोदर्यैः सह ॥ प्रपाठक ॥
6.12.m: I have entered inside the divine fortresses, / together with my village, for well-being, / out of the middle of the year, / together with all my brothers of the same womb. Prapāṭhaka.

6.12.s: prāham agāṃ devapurā ya evāsmi sa eva san | yo mā kaś cābhidāsati sa prajāpatim ṛcchatu ||
6.12.d: प्राहम् अगां देवपुरा य एवास्मि स एव सन् । यो मा कश् चाभिदासति स प्रजापतिम् ऋच्छतु ॥
6.12.m: I have entered the divine fortresses, / remaining just who I am. / Whoever assails me, / let him go to Prajāpati!

6.12.s: aśmāsi pratispaśaḥ pāhi riṣaḥ pāhi dviṣaḥ | pāhi daivyābhiśastyāḥ sa ma iha tanvaṃ pāhi ||
6.12.d: अश्मासि प्रतिस्पशः पाहि रिषः पाहि द्विषः । पाहि दैव्याभिशस्त्याः स म इह तन्वं पाहि ॥
6.12.m: Protect from harm, protect from hatred! / Protect from divine curse; / protect [my] body!

6.12.s: yo 'smān prācyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt | etat sa ṛcchād aśmavarma no 'stu ||
6.12.d: यो ऽस्मान् प्राच्या दिशो ऽघायुर् अभिदासात् । एतत् स ऋच्छाद् अश्मवर्म नो ऽस्तु ॥
6.12.m: Whoever, plotting evil, assails us from the eastern quarter, / may this stone armor be ours against him.

6.13.s: yo 'smān ūrdhvāyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt | etat sa ṛcchād aśmavarma no 'stu ||
6.13.d: यो ऽस्मान् ऊर्ध्वाया दिशो ऽघायुर् अभिदासात् । एतत् स ऋच्छाद् अश्मवर्म नो ऽस्तु ॥
6.13.m: Whoever, plotting evil, assails us from the upward quarter, / may this stone armor be ours against him.

6.14.s: mahākaṇṭhaṃ karīṣajam ūbadhyādam anāhutim | oṣṭhaḥ kokamukhaś ca yas tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
6.14.d: महाकण्ठं करीषजम् ऊबध्यादम् अनाहुतिम् । ओष्ठः कोकमुखश् च यस् तान् इतो नाशयामसि ॥
6.14.m: The large-throated, dung-born one, / the entrails-eater, who receives no offering, / he of the [protruding] lip, and the wolf-faced one— / these we banish from here.

6.14.s: rāmadantam avadalaṃ prahālam ahināsikam | upavartaṃ balāhakaṃ khelaṃ gardabhanādinaṃ gṛdhraṃ hastyāyanaṃ tān … ||
6.14.d: रामदन्तम् अवदलं प्रहालम् अहिनासिकम् । उपवर्तं बलाहकं खेलं गर्दभनादिनं गृध्रं हस्त्यायनं तान् … ॥
6.14.m: The black-toothed one, the gap-toothed, / the long-toothed and the snake-nosed, / the rolling one, the cloud-like, / the lame, the donkey-braying, / the vulture, the elephant-striding— / these […]

6.14.s: pramṛśyādinam abhyamaṃ bhīmahastaṃ marīmṛśam | trastākṣaṃ mṛdvaṅguliṃ nakhograṃ dantavīryaṃ tān … ||
6.14.d: प्रमृश्यादिनम् अभ्यमं भीमहस्तं मरीमृशम् । त्रस्ताक्षं मृद्वङ्गुलिं नखोग्रं दन्तवीर्यं तान् … ॥
6.14.m: The one eating what is seized, the distressing, / the terrible-handed, the groping, / the trembling-eyed, the soft-fingered, / the fierce-clawed, the tooth-valiant— / these […]

6.14.s: paryanyam abhipāpadaṃ jigīṣamāṇaṃ rūpakam | atho śalalyaṃ śevalaṃ tān … ||
6.14.d: पर्यन्यम् अभिपापदं जिगीषमाणं रूपकम् । अथो शलल्यं शेवलं तान् … ॥
6.14.m: The evil-footed, / the striving phantom, / and the porcupine-like, the mossy— / these […]

6.14.s: taṇḍam agretuṇḍikam aliṃśam uta vatsapam | dāmagranthiṃ sanisrasam araṇyeyaṃ cārmyeyaṃ tān … ||
6.14.d: तण्डम् अग्रेतुण्डिकम् अलिंशम् उत वत्सपम् । दामग्रन्थिं सनिस्रसम् अरण्येयं चार्म्येयं तान् … ॥
6.14.m: Taṇḍa, the prominent-snouted, / Aliṃśa and the calf-drinker, / the rope-knot, the Tottering One, / the forest-dweller and the leather-dweller— / these […]

6.14.s: idaṃ yaj jānukeśavaṃ rakṣaś caraty āsuraṃ bahiḥ prayutam icchati | aṃsūn pāṃsyūṃś ca keśyān arāyāñ chvakiṣkiṇas tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
6.14.d: इदं यज् जानुकेशवं रक्षश् चरत्य् आसुरं बहिः प्रयुतम् इच्छति । अंसून् पांस्यूंश् च केश्यान् अरायाञ् छ्वकिष्किणस् तान् इतो नाशयामसि ॥
6.14.m: This knee-haired demon, / demonic, that wanders about / seeking the strayed outside, / and the long-haired, / the Arāyīs with dog-tails— / these we banish from here.

6.14.s: yaḥ kumārāñ janasyātti taruṇān dāsa āsuraḥ | arāyaḥ keśy aghalo yo janān hanty atti ca tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
6.14.d: यः कुमाराञ् जनस्यात्ति तरुणान् दास आसुरः । अरायः केश्य् अघलो यो जनान् हन्त्य् अत्ति च तम् इतो नाशयामसि ॥
6.14.m: The demonic Dāsa who eats the children / of the people, the young ones, / the Arāya, long-haired, wicked, / who slays and eats people— / him we banish from here.

6.14.s: hirākṣo nāma gehyo 'rāyo nāma sūrtahā | tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
6.14.d: हिराक्षो नाम गेह्यो ऽरायो नाम सूर्तहा । तम् इतो नाशयामसि ॥
6.14.m: The domestic one named Vein-eyed, / the Arāya named Sūrtahan— / him we banish from here.

6.14.s: vitūlaṃ bhasvam ākhidaṃ vanakrośaṃ ca roruham | āmādaṃ prayutaiṣaṇaṃ paryundānaṃ paridravaṃ vṛkasya nyañcaṃ gaṅgaṇaṃ tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
6.14.d: वितूलं भस्वम् आखिदं वनक्रोशं च रोरुहम् । आमादं प्रयुतैषणं पर्युन्दानं परिद्रवं वृकस्य न्यञ्चं गङ्गणं तान् इतो नाशयामसि ॥
6.14.m: The reedless, the greedy, the scraper, / the forest-howler and the climber, / the raw-eater seeking the strayed, / the soaker, the rover, / the wolf's companion— / these we banish from here.

6.15.s: yaś ca bhūmā yā ca sphātir yorjā yo rasaś ca te | harāmi śakra tām̐ ahaṃ tvayā prattāṃ śacīpate ||
6.15.d: यश् च भूमा या च स्फातिर् योर्जा यो रसश् च ते । हरामि शक्र ताँ अहं त्वया प्रत्तां शचीपते ॥
6.15.m: Whatever abundance and whatever increase, / whatever sap and whatever juice is yours, / O mighty one, that I take, / bestowed by you, O lord of might.

6.15.s: kṣetrātkṣetrād ā harāmi sphātiṃ sarvāṃ śacīpate | tvayāhaṃ vṛtrahan prattam ā harāmi gṛhām̐ upa ||
6.15.d: क्षेत्रात्क्षेत्राद् आ हरामि स्फातिं सर्वां शचीपते । त्वयाहं वृत्रहन् प्रत्तम् आ हरामि गृहाँ उप ॥
6.15.m: From field to field I bring / all increase, O lord of might. / Bestowed by you, O slayer of Vṛtra, / I bring it to [my] home.

6.15.s: yas te sītābhagaḥ kṣetre yā rāddhir yac ca śīyate | atho yā niṣṭhā te kṣetre tāṃ ta ādiṣi brahmaṇā ||
6.15.d: यस् ते सीताभगः क्षेत्रे या राद्धिर् यच् च शीयते । अथो या निष्ठा ते क्षेत्रे तां त आदिषि ब्रह्मणा ॥
6.15.m: Whatever furrow-share is yours in the field, / whatever success and whatever falls, / and whatever limit is yours in the field, / that I have assigned to you by sacred formula.

6.15.s: yat khale yan mayāre yad goṣṭhe yac ca śevadhau | atho yat kumbhyāṃ śaye tasya te rasam ā dade ||
6.15.d: यत् खले यन् मयारे यद् गोष्ठे यच् च शेवधौ । अथो यत् कुम्भ्यां शये तस्य ते रसम् आ ददे ॥
6.15.m: What is on the threshing-floor, what in the granary, / what in the pen and what in the treasure-chest, / and what lies in the jar, / of that I take your juice.

6.15.s: ūrjā yā te niruptasya ūrjā yāvahatasya te | ūrjāṃ te piṣyamāṇasya ūrjāṃ piṣṭāt ta ā dade ||
6.15.d: ऊर्जा या ते निरुप्तस्य ऊर्जा यावहतस्य ते । ऊर्जां ते पिष्यमाणस्य ऊर्जां पिष्टात् त आ ददे ॥
6.15.m: Whatever sap is yours when poured out, / whatever sap is yours when threshed, / the sap of you when being ground, / the sap from what is ground I take from you.

6.15.s: … te niruptasya ūrjā yāvahatasya te | ūrjāṃ te pacyamānasya ūrjāṃ pakvāt te … ||
6.15.d: … ते निरुप्तस्य ऊर्जा यावहतस्य ते । ऊर्जां ते पच्यमानस्य ऊर्जां पक्वात् ते … ॥
6.15.m: [Whatever sap] of you when poured out, / whatever sap is yours when threshed, / the sap of you when being cooked, / the sap from what is cooked […]

6.15.s: ūrjā yā te praṇaddhasya ūrjā yā mathitasya te | ūrjāṃ te duhyamānasya ūrjāṃ dugdhāt ta ā dade ||
6.15.d: ऊर्जा या ते प्रणद्धस्य ऊर्जा या मथितस्य ते । ऊर्जां ते दुह्यमानस्य ऊर्जां दुग्धात् त आ ददे ॥
6.15.m: Whatever sap is yours when tied up, / whatever sap is yours when churned, / the sap of you when being milked, / the sap from what is milked I take from you.

6.15.s: ā te dade gavām ūrjām ūrjām avibhya ā dade | ajābhya ūrjām ādāya ā ta ekaśaphād dade ||
6.15.d: आ ते ददे गवाम् ऊर्जाम् ऊर्जाम् अविभ्य आ ददे । अजाभ्य ऊर्जाम् आदाय आ त एकशफाद् ददे ॥
6.15.m: I take for you the sap of the cows, / the sap from the sheep I take; / having taken the sap from the goats, / I take [it] for you.

6.15.s: ūrjā yā te puruṣeṣu ūrjā vitte ca vedye | ūrjāṃ te sarveṣām ahaṃ gṛhāṇāṃ brahmaṇā dade ||
6.15.d: ऊर्जा या ते पुरुषेषु ऊर्जा वित्ते च वेद्ये । ऊर्जां ते सर्वेषाम् अहं गृहाणां ब्रह्मणा ददे ॥
6.15.m: Whatever sap is yours among men, / whatever sap in property and in what is to be acquired, / the sap of all your houses / I take by sacred formula.

6.16.s: pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm | yasya trito vy ojasā vṛtraṃ viparvam ardayat ||
6.16.d: पितुं नु स्तोषं महो धर्माणं तविषीम् । यस्य त्रितो व्य् ओजसा वृत्रं विपर्वम् अर्दयत् ॥
6.16.m: Now shall I praise food, / the great sustainer, the power, / through whose might Trita / shattered Vṛtra limb from limb.

6.16.s: svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe | asmākam avitā bhava ||
6.16.d: स्वादो पितो मधो पितो वयं त्वा ववृमहे । अस्माकम् अविता भव ॥
6.16.m: O sweet food, O honeyed food, / we […] you; / become our protector.

6.16.s: upa naḥ pitav ā gahi śivaḥ śivābhir ūtibhiḥ | mayobhūr adviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||
6.16.d: उप नः पितव् आ गहि शिवः शिवाभिर् ऊतिभिः । मयोभूर् अद्विषेण्यः सखा सुशेव एधि नः ॥
6.16.m: Come unto us, O food, / auspicious with auspicious aids; / be a joy-bringer, not to be hated, / a most gracious friend to us.

6.16.s: tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsy anu viṣṭhitāḥ | divi vātā iva śritāḥ ||
6.16.d: तव त्ये पितो रसा रजांस्य् अनु विष्ठिताः । दिवि वाता इव श्रिताः ॥
6.16.m: Those juices of yours, O food, / are spread across the spaces, / like winds established in heaven.

6.16.s: tava tye pito dadatas tava svādiṣṭha te pito | pra svādmāno rasānāṃ tuvigrīvā iverate ||
6.16.d: तव त्ये पितो ददतस् तव स्वादिष्ठ ते पितो । प्र स्वाद्मानो रसानां तुविग्रीवा इवेरते ॥
6.16.m: Those [givers] of yours, O food, giving, / O sweetest food, of yours, / the delights of your juices / rush forth like stout-necked ones.

6.16.s: tve pito mahānāṃ devānāṃ mano hitam | akāri cāru ketunā tavāhim avasāvadhīt ||
6.16.d: त्वे पितो महानां देवानां मनो हितम् । अकारि चारु केतुना तवाहिम् अवसावधीत् ॥
6.16.m: In you, O food, is placed the mind / of the great gods. / A fair [deed] was done by the banner: / with your help he slew the serpent.

6.16.s: yad adaḥ pito ajagan vivasva parvatānām | atrā cin no madho pito 'raṃ bhakṣāya gamyāḥ ||
6.16.d: यद् अदः पितो अजगन् विवस्व पर्वतानाम् । अत्रा चिन् नो मधो पितो ऽरं भक्षाय गम्याः ॥
6.16.m: When, O food, you went yonder / to the expanse of the mountains, / even here, O honeyed food, / may you come suitably for our enjoyment.

6.16.s: yat te soma gavāśiro yavāśiro bhajāmahe | vātāpe pīva id bhava ||
6.16.d: यत् ते सोम गवाशिरो यवाशिरो भजामहे । वातापे पीव इद् भव ॥
6.16.m: What of yours, O Soma, mixed with milk, / mixed with barley we enjoy, / be fattening to Vātāpi.
What of waters, of plants / we taste as our portion […]

6.16.s: karambha oṣadhe bhava pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ | vātāpe pīva id bhava ||
6.16.d: करम्भ ओषधे भव पीवो वृक्क उदारथिः । वातापे पीव इद् भव ॥
6.16.m: Become groats, O plant, / fat, kidney, swelling; / be fattening to Vātāpi.

6.16.s: taṃ tvā vayaṃ pito vacobhir gāvo na havyā suṣūdima | asmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādaṃ devebhyas tvā sadhamādam ||
6.16.d: तं त्वा वयं पितो वचोभिर् गावो न हव्या सुषूदिम । अस्मभ्यं त्वा सधमादं देवेभ्यस् त्वा सधमादम् ॥
6.16.m: To you, O food, with words, / like cows with offerings, have we given pleasure. / [May you be] for us a companion at the feast, / for the gods a companion at the feast.

6.17.s: prati tyaṃ cārum adhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase | marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
6.17.d: प्रति त्यं चारुम् अध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे । मरुद्भिर् अग्न आ गहि ॥
6.17.m: To this fair sacrifice / you are invoked for the drinking. / Come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

6.17.s: nahi devo na martyo mahas tava kratuṃ paraḥ … ||
6.17.d: नहि देवो न मर्त्यो महस् तव क्रतुं परः … ॥
6.17.m: Neither god nor mortal / is beyond your great wisdom […]

6.17.s: ye maho rajaso vidur viśve devāso adruhaḥ … ||
6.17.d: ये महो रजसो विदुर् विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः … ॥
6.17.m: Who know of the great space, / all the gods without deceit […]
Who are bright, of terrible forms, / of good dominion, destroyers of foes […]

6.17.s: ya ugrā arkam ānṛcur anādhṛṣṭāsa ojasā … ||
6.17.d: य उग्रा अर्कम् आनृचुर् अनाधृष्टास ओजसा … ॥
6.17.m: Who, fierce, have sung the song of praise, / unassailable in might […]

6.17.s: ye nākasyādhi rocane divi devāsa āsate … ||
6.17.d: ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि देवास आसते … ॥
6.17.m: Who upon the vault's brilliance / sit as gods in heaven […]

6.17.s: ya īṅkhayanti parvatān tiraḥ samudram ojasā … ||
6.17.d: य ईङ्खयन्ति पर्वतान् तिरः समुद्रम् ओजसा … ॥
6.17.m: Who shake the mountains / across the sea by their might […]

6.17.s: ā ye tanvanti raśmibhis tiraḥ samudram arṇavam … ||
6.17.d: आ ये तन्वन्ति रश्मिभिस् तिरः समुद्रम् अर्णवम् … ॥
6.17.m: Who spread out with rays / across the billowing sea […]

6.17.s: abhi tvā pūrvapītaye sṛjāmi somyaṃ madhu … ||
6.17.d: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतये सृजामि सोम्यं मधु … ॥
6.17.m: For you for the first drink / I pour out the sweet honey of Soma […]

6.17.s: ā yantu maruto gaṇai stutā dadhatu no rayim … ||
6.17.d: आ यन्तु मरुतो गणै स्तुता दधतु नो रयिम् … ॥
6.17.m: Let the Maruts come with their troops; / praised, let them bestow wealth on us […]

6.17.s: ā tvā kaṇvā ahūṣata gṛṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ | marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
6.17.d: आ त्वा कण्वा अहूषत गृणन्ति विप्र ते धियः । मरुद्भिर् अग्न आ गहि ॥
6.17.m: The Kaṇvas have called on you; / the prayers of the inspired poet sing praise to you. / Come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

6.18.s: saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ saṃ pūṣā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃ māyam agniḥ siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇotu me ||
6.18.d: सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः सं पूषा सं बृहस्पतिः । सं मायम् अग्निः सिञ्चतु प्रजया च धनेन च दीर्घम् आयुष् कृणोतु मे ॥
6.18.m: May the Maruts sprinkle me together, / Pūṣan together, Bṛhaspati together; / may this Agni sprinkle me together / with offspring and with wealth; / may he make long life for me.

6.18.s: … siñcantv ādityāḥ saṃ mā siñcantv agnayaḥ | indraḥ sam asmān siñcatu … ||
6.18.d: … सिञ्चन्त्व् आदित्याः सं मा सिञ्चन्त्व् अग्नयः । इन्द्रः सम् अस्मान् सिञ्चतु … ॥
6.18.m: [May] the Ādityas sprinkle [me] together, / may the fires sprinkle me together; / may Indra sprinkle us together […]

6.18.s: … siñcantv aruṣāḥ sam arkā ṛṣayaś ca ye | pūṣā sam … ||
6.18.d: … सिञ्चन्त्व् अरुषाः सम् अर्का ऋषयश् च ये । पूषा सम् … ॥
6.18.m: [May] the red steeds sprinkle [me] together, / together the chants and the ṛṣis who are [there]; / Pūṣan together […]

6.18.s: … siñcantu gandharvāpsarasaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu devatāḥ | bhagaḥ sam … ||
6.18.d: … सिञ्चन्तु गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सं मा सिञ्चन्तु देवताः । भगः सम् … ॥
6.18.m: [May] the Gandharvas and Apsarases sprinkle [me] together, / may the deities sprinkle me together; / Bhaga together […]

6.18.s: … siñcantu pṛthivīḥ saṃ mā siñcantu yā divaḥ | antarikṣaṃ sam … ||
6.18.d: … सिञ्चन्तु पृथिवीः सं मा सिञ्चन्तु या दिवः । अन्तरिक्षं सम् … ॥
6.18.m: [May] the earths sprinkle [me] together, / may those of heaven sprinkle me together; / the intermediate space together […]

6.18.s: … siñcantu pradiśaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu yā diśaḥ | āśā sam … ||
6.18.d: … सिञ्चन्तु प्रदिशः सं मा सिञ्चन्तु या दिशः । आशा सम् … ॥
6.18.m: [May] the intermediate quarters sprinkle [me] together, / may the quarters sprinkle me together; / the regions together […]

6.18.s: … siñcantu nadyaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu sindhavaḥ | samudraḥ sam … ||
6.18.d: … सिञ्चन्तु नद्यः सं मा सिञ्चन्तु सिन्धवः । समुद्रः सम् … ॥
6.18.m: [May] the streams sprinkle [me] together, / may the rivers sprinkle me together; / the ocean together […]

6.18.s: … siñcantu kṛṣayaḥ saṃ mā siñcantv oṣadhīḥ | somaḥ sam … ||
6.18.d: … सिञ्चन्तु कृषयः सं मा सिञ्चन्त्व् ओषधीः । सोमः सम् … ॥
6.18.m: [May] the ploughings sprinkle [me] together, / may the plants sprinkle me together; / Soma together […]

6.18.s: saṃ mā siñcantu yā āpaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu vṛṣṭayaḥ | sarasvatī sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇotu me ||
6.18.d: सं मा सिञ्चन्तु या आपः सं मा सिञ्चन्तु वृष्टयः । सरस्वती सम् अस्मान् सिञ्चतु प्रजया च धनेन च दीर्घम् आयुष् कृणोतु मे ॥
6.18.m: May the waters sprinkle me together, / may the rains sprinkle me together; / may Sarasvatī sprinkle us together / with offspring and with wealth; / may she make long life for me.

6.19.s: saṃ bhago varcasā māgne saṃ viṣṇuḥ puṣṭyā sicat | kṣatraṃ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
6.19.d: सं भगो वर्चसा माग्ने सं विष्णुः पुष्ट्या सिचत् । क्षत्रं सम् अस्मान् सिञ्चतु प्रजया च धनेन च आयुष्मन्तं कृणोतु मा ॥
6.19.m: May Bhaga sprinkle me together with luster, O Agni, / Viṣṇu with nourishment; / may dominion sprinkle us together / with offspring and with wealth; / make me full of life.

6.19.s: saṃ virāḍ varcasā māgne saṃ deṣṭrī puṣṭyā sicat | iḍā sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca … ||
6.19.d: सं विराड् वर्चसा माग्ने सं देष्ट्री पुष्ट्या सिचत् । इडा सम् अस्मान् सिञ्चतु प्रजया च … ॥
6.19.m: May Virāj sprinkle me together with luster, O Agni, / Deṣṭrī with nourishment; / may Iḍā sprinkle us together / with offspring and […]

6.19.s: saṃ dhātā varcasā māgne saṃ siktiḥ puṣṭyā sicat | saṃ devo asmān aryamā prajayā ca … ||
6.19.d: सं धाता वर्चसा माग्ने सं सिक्तिः पुष्ट्या सिचत् । सं देवो अस्मान् अर्यमा प्रजया च … ॥
6.19.m: May Dhātṛ sprinkle me together with luster, O Agni, / the pouring with nourishment; / may the god Aryaman [sprinkle] us together / with offspring and […]

6.19.s: sam aṃśo varcasā māgne saṃ vāyuḥ puṣṭyā sicat | vātaḥ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca … ||
6.19.d: सम् अंशो वर्चसा माग्ने सं वायुः पुष्ट्या सिचत् । वातः सम् अस्मान् सिञ्चतु प्रजया च … ॥
6.19.m: May Aṃśa sprinkle me together with luster, O Agni, / Vāyu with nourishment; / may Vāta sprinkle us together / with offspring and […]

6.19.s: saṃ sabhā varcasā māgne saṃ surā puṣṭyā sicat | sūryā sam … ||
6.19.d: सं सभा वर्चसा माग्ने सं सुरा पुष्ट्या सिचत् । सूर्या सम् … ॥
6.19.m: May the assembly sprinkle me together with luster, O Agni, / liquor with nourishment; / Sūryā together […]

6.19.s: saṃ savitā varcasā māgne saṃ sūryaḥ puṣṭyā sicat | candraḥ sam … ||
6.19.d: सं सविता वर्चसा माग्ने सं सूर्यः पुष्ट्या सिचत् । चन्द्रः सम् … ॥
6.19.m: May Savitṛ sprinkle me together with luster, O Agni, / Sūrya with nourishment; / the moon together […]

6.19.s: saṃ paśavo varcasā māgne saṃ yajñaḥ puṣṭyā sicat | dakṣiṇā sam … ||
6.19.d: सं पशवो वर्चसा माग्ने सं यज्ञः पुष्ट्या सिचत् । दक्षिणा सम् … ॥
6.19.m: May the cattle sprinkle me together with luster, O Agni, / the sacrifice with nourishment; / the sacrificial gift together […]

6.19.s: saṃ mā siñcatu draviṇaṃ saṃ mā siñcatv indriyam | tejaḥ sam … ||
6.19.d: सं मा सिञ्चतु द्रविणं सं मा सिञ्चत्व् इन्द्रियम् । तेजः सम् … ॥
6.19.m: May wealth sprinkle me together, / may bodily power sprinkle me together; / fiery energy together […]

6.19.s: saṃ mā siñcantu varcāṃsi saṃ mā siñcantu bhūtayaḥ | satyaṃ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
6.19.d: सं मा सिञ्चन्तु वर्चांसि सं मा सिञ्चन्तु भूतयः । सत्यं सम् अस्मान् सिञ्चतु प्रजया च धनेन च आयुष्मन्तं कृणोतु मा ॥
6.19.m: May splendors sprinkle me together, / may prosperity sprinkle me together; / may truth sprinkle us together / with offspring and with wealth; / make me long-lived.

6.20.s: ā rātri pārthivaṃ rajaḥ pitur aprāyi dhāmabhiḥ | divaḥ sadāṃsi bṛhatī vi tiṣṭhasa ā tveṣaṃ vartate tamaḥ ||
6.20.d: आ रात्रि पार्थिवं रजः पितुर् अप्रायि धामभिः । दिवः सदांसि बृहती वि तिष्ठस आ त्वेषं वर्तते तमः ॥
6.20.m: [Fill] the earthly realm, O night, / with the stations of the father; / lofty, stand apart across the seats of heaven; / radiant darkness moves near.

6.20.s: na yasyāḥ pāraṃ dadṛśe na yoyuvad viśvam asyāṃ ni viśate yad ejati | ariṣṭāsas ta urvi tamasvati rātri pāram aśīmahi bhadre pāram aśīmahi ||
6.20.d: न यस्याः पारं ददृशे न योयुवद् विश्वम् अस्यां नि विशते यद् एजति । अरिष्टासस् त उर्वि तमस्वति रात्रि पारम् अशीमहि भद्रे पारम् अशीमहि ॥
6.20.m: Whose boundary is not seen, nor does it part; / all that moves settles down in her. / Unharmed, O broad, dark / night, may we reach the other side, / O auspicious one, may we reach the other side.

6.20.s: ye te rātri nṛcakṣaso draṣṭāro navatir nava | aśītiḥ santy aṣṭā uto te sapta saptatiḥ ||
6.20.d: ये ते रात्रि नृचक्षसो द्रष्टारो नवतिर् नव । अशीतिः सन्त्य् अष्टा उतो ते सप्त सप्ततिः ॥
6.20.m: The men-watching watchers of yours, / O night, that are ninety-nine, / or are eighty-eight, / and also your seventy-seven,

6.20.s: ṣaṣṭiś ca ṣaṭ ca revati pañcāśat pañca sumnayi | catvāraś catvāriṃśac ca trayas triṃśac ca vājini ||
6.20.d: षष्टिश् च षट् च रेवति पञ्चाशत् पञ्च सुम्नयि । चत्वारश् चत्वारिंशच् च त्रयस् त्रिंशच् च वाजिनि ॥
6.20.m: and sixty-six, O opulent one, / fifty-five, O benevolent one, / and forty-four, / and thirty-three, O swift one,

6.20.s: dvā ca viṃśatiś ca te rātry ekādaśāvamāḥ | tebhir no 'dya pāyubhir ni pāhi duhitar divaḥ ||
6.20.d: द्वा च विंशतिश् च ते रात्र्य् एकादशावमाः । तेभिर् नो ऽद्य पायुभिर् नि पाहि दुहितर् दिवः ॥
6.20.m: and twenty-two of yours, / O night, [and] the lowest eleven: / with those protectors / guard us down today, O daughter of heaven.

6.20.s: rakṣā mākir ṇo aghaśaṃsa īśata mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||
6.20.d: रक्षा माकिर् णो अघशंस ईशत मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ॥
6.20.m: Protect! May no evil-speaker have power over us; / may no ill-speaker have power over us.

6.20.s: mā no adya gavāṃ steno māvīnāṃ vṛka īśata | māśvānāṃ bhadre taskaro mā nṛṇāṃ yātudhānyaḥ ||
6.20.d: मा नो अद्य गवां स्तेनो मावीनां वृक ईशत । माश्वानां भद्रे तस्करो मा नृणां यातुधान्यः ॥
6.20.m: May the thief of cattle not have power over us today, / nor the wolf of sheep; / may the robber of horses [not have power over us], O auspicious one, / nor the female sorcerers of men.

6.20.s: paramebhiḥ pathibhi steno dhāvatu taskaraḥ | pareṇa datvatī rajjuḥ pareṇāghāyur arṣatu ||
6.20.d: परमेभिः पथिभि स्तेनो धावतु तस्करः । परेण दत्वती रज्जुः परेणाघायुर् अर्षतु ॥
6.20.m: By the farthest paths / let the thief, the robber run; / far away [let] the toothed rope [go], / far away let the malicious one rush.

6.20.s: andhaṃ rātri tiṣṭhadhūmam aśīrṣāṇam ahiṃ kṛṇu | hanū vṛkasya jambhaya ā stenaṃ drupade jahi ||
6.20.d: अन्धं रात्रि तिष्ठधूमम् अशीर्षाणम् अहिं कृणु । हनू वृकस्य जम्भय आ स्तेनं द्रुपदे जहि ॥
6.20.m: Blind, O night, / headless make the snake; / crush the jaws of the wolf; / smite the thief into the wooden post.

6.20.s: tvayi rātri vasāmasi svapiṣyāmasi jāgṛhi | gobhyo naḥ śarma yaccha aśvebhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ ||
6.20.d: त्वयि रात्रि वसामसि स्वपिष्यामसि जागृहि । गोभ्यो नः शर्म यच्छ अश्वेभ्यः पुरुषेभ्यः ॥
6.20.m: In you, O night, we abide; / we will sleep, do watch; / grant protection to our cattle, / to [our] horses, to [our] men.

6.21.s: atho yāni ca vasmahe yāni cāntaḥ parīṇahi | tāni te pari dadmasi ||
6.21.d: अथो यानि च वस्महे यानि चान्तः परीणहि । तानि ते परि दद्मसि ॥
6.21.m: And also what we wear, / and what is inside the chest: / those things we commit to you.

6.21.s: rātri mātar uṣase naḥ pari dehi | uṣā no ahne pari dadātv ahas tubhyaṃ vibhāvari ||
6.21.d: रात्रि मातर् उषसे नः परि देहि । उषा नो अह्ने परि ददात्व् अहस् तुभ्यं विभावरि ॥
6.21.m: O Mother Night, commit us to the dawn; / may the dawn commit us to the day, / the day to you, O radiant one.

6.21.s: yat kiṃ cedaṃ patayati yat kiṃ cedaṃ sarīsṛpam | yat kiṃ ca padvad āsanvat tasmāt tvaṃ rātri pāhi naḥ ||
6.21.d: यत् किं चेदं पतयति यत् किं चेदं सरीसृपम् । यत् किं च पद्वद् आसन्वत् तस्मात् त्वं रात्रि पाहि नः ॥
6.21.m: Whatever flies here, / whatever crawls here, / and whatever has feet and mouth: / from that, O night, protect us.

6.21.s: sā paścāt pāhi sā puraḥ sottarād adharād uta | gopāya no vibhāvari stotāras ta iha smasi ||
6.21.d: सा पश्चात् पाहि सा पुरः सोत्तराद् अधराद् उत । गोपाय नो विभावरि स्तोतारस् त इह स्मसि ॥
6.21.m: Protect from behind, protect from before, / from above and from below; / guard us, O radiant one; / your praisers are we here.

6.21.s: ye rātrim anutiṣṭhanti ye ca bhūteṣu jāgrati | paśūn ye sarvān rakṣanti te na ātmasu jāgratu te naḥ paśuṣu jāgratu ||
6.21.d: ये रात्रिम् अनुतिष्ठन्ति ये च भूतेषु जाग्रति । पशून् ये सर्वान् रक्षन्ति ते न आत्मसु जाग्रतु ते नः पशुषु जाग्रतु ॥
6.21.m: Those who attend the night, / and who watch over beings, / who protect all the cattle: / may they watch over our souls, / may they watch over our cattle.

6.21.s: veda vai rātri te nāma ghṛtācī nāma vā asi | tāṃ tvā bharadvājo veda sā no vitte 'dhi jāgṛhi ||
6.21.d: वेद वै रात्रि ते नाम घृताची नाम वा असि । तां त्वा भरद्वाजो वेद सा नो वित्ते ऽधि जागृहि ॥
6.21.m: I know your name, O night; / indeed Ghṛtācī is your name. / As such Bharadvāja knows you; / so watch over our property.

6.22.s: brahmāsya śiro bṛhad asya pṛṣṭhaṃ vāmadevyam udaram odanasya | chandāṃsi pakṣau mukham asya satyaṃ viṣṭārī yajñas tapaso 'dhi jātaḥ ||
6.22.d: ब्रह्मास्य शिरो बृहद् अस्य पृष्ठं वामदेव्यम् उदरम् ओदनस्य । छन्दांसि पक्षौ मुखम् अस्य सत्यं विष्टारी यज्ञस् तपसो ऽधि जातः ॥
6.22.m: The brahman is its head, the Bṛhat its back, / the Vāmadevya the belly of the porridge; / the meters are its wings, its face is truth; / the expansive sacrifice is born from heat.

6.22.s: anasthāḥ śuddhāḥ pavanena pūtāḥ śucayaḥ śucīn api yanti lokān | viṣṭāriṇam odanaṃ ye pacanti naiṣāṃ śiśnaṃ pra dahati jātavedāḥ ||
6.22.d: अनस्थाः शुद्धाः पवनेन पूताः शुचयः शुचीन् अपि यन्ति लोकान् । विष्टारिणम् ओदनं ये पचन्ति नैषां शिश्नं प्र दहति जातवेदाः ॥
6.22.m:
Bones gone, pure, cleansed by the sieve, / radiant, they go to radiant worlds; / they who cook the expansive porridge: / Jātavedas does not burn away their penis.

Jātavedas does not burn away their penis; / in the heavenly world they have many women; / Yama does not steal away their seed.

6.22.s: naiṣāṃ śiśnaṃ pra dahati jātavedāḥ svarge loke bahu straiṇam eṣām | nainān yamaḥ pari muṣṇāti retaḥ ||
6.22.d: नैषां शिश्नं प्र दहति जातवेदाः स्वर्गे लोके बहु स्त्रैणम् एषाम् । नैनान् यमः परि मुष्णाति रेतः ॥

6.22.s: āste yama upa yāti devān saṃ gandharvair madati somyaiḥ | viṣṭāriṇam odanaṃ ye pacanti nainān avartiḥ sacate kutaś cana ||
6.22.d: आस्ते यम उप याति देवान् सं गन्धर्वैर् मदति सोम्यैः । विष्टारिणम् ओदनं ये पचन्ति नैनान् अवर्तिः सचते कुतश् चन ॥
6.22.m: He sits with Yama, goes to the gods, / revels with the Soma-loving Gandharvas; / they who cook the expansive porridge: / distress does not cling to them from anywhere.

6.22.s: rathī ha bhūtvā rathayāna īyate pakṣī ha bhūtvāpi divaṃ sam eti | eṣa yajño vitato vahiṣṭho viṣṭārī pakvo divam ā sasāda ||
6.22.d: रथी ह भूत्वा रथयान ईयते पक्षी ह भूत्वापि दिवं सम् एति । एष यज्ञो विततो वहिष्ठो विष्टारी पक्वो दिवम् आ ससाद ॥
6.22.m: Becoming a charioteer, he drives in a chariot; / becoming winged, he reaches heaven; / this sacrifice, spread out, best at carrying, / the expansive [porridge], cooked, has sat down in heaven.

6.22.s: caturaḥ kumbhāṃś caturdhā dadāti kṣīreṇa pūrṇān udakena dadhnā | etās tvā kulyā upa yantu viśvataḥ svarge loke svadhayā pinvamānāḥ ||
6.22.d: चतुरः कुम्भांश् चतुर्धा ददाति क्षीरेण पूर्णान् उदकेन दध्ना । एतास् त्वा कुल्या उप यन्तु विश्वतः स्वर्गे लोके स्वधया पिन्वमानाः ॥
6.22.m: He gives four pots in four ways, / full of milk, with water, [and] with curd. / Let these water-channels come to you from all sides, / swelling with the ancestral offering in the heavenly world.

6.22.s: ghṛtahradā madhukūlāḥ surodakāḥ kṣīreṇa pūrṇā udakena dadhnā | etās tvā kulyā upa yantu viśvahā svarge loke svadhayā mādayantīḥ ||
6.22.d: घृतह्रदा मधुकूलाः सुरोदकाः क्षीरेण पूर्णा उदकेन दध्ना । एतास् त्वा कुल्या उप यन्तु विश्वहा स्वर्गे लोके स्वधया मादयन्तीः ॥
6.22.m: Ponds of ghee, shores of honey, waters of liquor, / filled with milk, with water, with curd: / let these water-channels come to you forever, / intoxicating with the ancestral offering in the heavenly world.

6.22.s: puṇḍarīkaṃ kumudaṃ saṃ tanoti bisaṃ śālūkaṃ śaphako mulālī | svarge loke svadhayā pinvamānā upa mā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samaktāḥ ||
6.22.d: पुण्डरीकं कुमुदं सं तनोति बिसं शालूकं शफको मुलाली । स्वर्गे लोके स्वधया पिन्वमाना उप मा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्करिणीः समक्ताः ॥
6.22.m: Lotus and water-lily it spreads out, / lotus-fiber, edible root, water-chestnut, lotus-shoot; / swelling with the ancestral offering in the heavenly world, / may the lotus-ponds, anointed, attend upon me.

6.22.s: yam odanaṃ pacāmi śraddadhāno viṣṭāriṇaṃ lokajitaṃ svargam | sa me mā kṣeṣṭa sadam aśyamāno viśvarūpā kāmadughā dhenur astu me ||
6.22.d: यम् ओदनं पचामि श्रद्दधानो विष्टारिणं लोकजितं स्वर्गम् । स मे मा क्षेष्ट सदम् अश्यमानो विश्वरूपा कामदुघा धेनुर् अस्तु मे ॥
6.22.m: The porridge which I, having faith, cook, / the expansive, world-winning, heavenly [porridge]: / may it not fail me when constantly eaten; / may it be for me an all-formed, wish-granting milch cow.

6.22.s: vṛṣabhaṃ santaṃ saha sūnṛtayā svarge loke amṛtaṃ duhānam | ye me putrāḥ pitaraś ca santi te tvā viṣṭārinn upa sarve sadeyuḥ ||
6.22.d: वृषभं सन्तं सह सूनृतया स्वर्गे लोके अमृतं दुहानम् । ये मे पुत्राः पितरश् च सन्ति ते त्वा विष्टारिन्न् उप सर्वे सदेयुः ॥
6.22.m: Being a bull together with generosity, / yielding nectar in the heavenly world: / whoever are my sons and fathers, / may they all sit beside you, O expansive one.

6.22.s: ya imān yajñān abhi vitaṣṭāra yasyeme lokāḥ svadhayā samaktāḥ | ye me pautrā uta ye pitāmahās tebhyo viṣṭārinn amṛtāni dhukṣva ||
6.22.d: य इमान् यज्ञान् अभि वितष्टार यस्येमे लोकाः स्वधया समक्ताः । ये मे पौत्रा उत ये पितामहास् तेभ्यो विष्टारिन्न् अमृतानि धुक्ष्व ॥
6.22.m: Who [looks] towards these sacrifices, / for whom these worlds are anointed with the ancestral offering: / whoever are my grandsons and who are grandfathers, / for them, O expansive one, yield nectars.

6.22.s: yadi pṛthivīṃ yady antarikṣaṃ yadi divaṃ devatā vā jagantha | ye me prapautrāḥ prapitāmahāś ca te tvā viṣṭārinn anu pra jñeṣur atra ||
6.22.d: यदि पृथिवीं यद्य् अन्तरिक्षं यदि दिवं देवता वा जगन्थ । ये मे प्रपौत्राः प्रपितामहाश् च ते त्वा विष्टारिन्न् अनु प्र ज्ञेषुर् अत्र ॥
6.22.m: Whether you have gone to earth, or to the atmosphere, / or to heaven, or to the deities: / whoever are my great-grandsons and great-grandfathers, / may they recognize you here, O expansive one.

6.22.s: svarge loke apsarasa enāñ jāyā bhūtvopa śerate | viṣṭāriṇam odanaṃ ye pacanty asmiṃl loke dakṣiṇayā pariṣkṛtam ||
6.22.d: स्वर्गे लोके अप्सरस एनाञ् जाया भूत्वोप शेरते । विष्टारिणम् ओदनं ये पचन्त्य् अस्मिंल् लोके दक्षिणया परिष्कृतम् ॥
6.22.m: In the heavenly world the Apsarases / lie beside [him], having become his wives, / [for him] who cooks the expansive porridge, / adorned with the sacrificial gift in this world.

6.23.s: nir ṇudaināṃ pra ṇudaināṃ svān nipadanād adhi | vibhraṃśam asyai kṛṇmo vi gṛhair bhraṃśatām asau ||
6.23.d: निर् णुदैनां प्र णुदैनां स्वान् निपदनाद् अधि । विभ्रंशम् अस्यै कृण्मो वि गृहैर् भ्रंशताम् असौ ॥
6.23.m: Push her out, drive her forth, / away from her own dwelling place! / We cause downfall for her; / may that woman fall away from [her] house.

6.23.s: apāñcaṃ patim ā kurv adharācīṃ striyaṃ naya | atīmān daśa parvatān atīmā nāvyā daśa ||
6.23.d: अपाञ्चं पतिम् आ कुर्व् अधराचीं स्त्रियं नय । अतीमान् दश पर्वतान् अतीमा नाव्या दश ॥
6.23.m: Make the husband facing away; / lead the woman downward, / beyond these ten mountains, / beyond these ten navigable rivers.

6.23.s: adharācīm avācīm atho akuśalāṃ diśam | vibhraṃśam asyai kṛṇmas tenaināṃ pra dahāmasi ||
6.23.d: अधराचीम् अवाचीम् अथो अकुशलां दिशम् । विभ्रंशम् अस्यै कृण्मस् तेनैनां प्र दहामसि ॥
6.23.m: Downward, turning downwards / and to the [nether] quarter: / we cause downfall for her; / thereby we burn her away.

6.23.s: āja nir aja bilaṃ bilād araṇyam ā kurv araṇyād araṇaṃ janam | mṛgām̐ anu pra pātaya vātasyaināṃ śikhāṃ kuru ||
6.23.d: आज निर् अज बिलं बिलाद् अरण्यम् आ कुर्व् अरण्याद् अरणं जनम् । मृगाँ अनु प्र पातय वातस्यैनां शिखां कुरु ॥
6.23.m: Drive [her], drive [her] out to the hole; / from the hole turn [her] to the wilderness, / from the wilderness to strange folk. / Make [her] fly after the wild beasts; / make her the crest of the wind.

6.23.s: vātāgre asyā hṛdayaṃ mano reṣmaṇi dadhmasi | vibhraṃśam asyai kṛṇmo vidhvaṃśam āsaktaṃ dame ||
6.23.d: वाताग्रे अस्या हृदयं मनो रेष्मणि दध्मसि । विभ्रंशम् अस्यै कृण्मो विध्वंशम् आसक्तं दमे ॥
6.23.m: At the front of the wind her heart, / [her] mind in the whirlwind we place. / We cause downfall for her / in the home.

6.23.s: sarvam anu pari plavatām antarā dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe | yathānavadhṛtā carād vṛṣatūlam ivopari ||
6.23.d: सर्वम् अनु परि प्लवताम् अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी उभे । यथानवधृता चराद् वृषतूलम् इवोपरि ॥
6.23.m: Let her float all about / between both heaven and earth, / so that unheld she may wander, / like the tuft of a thistle above.

6.23.s: aśam asyai vāto vātv aśaṃ tapatu sūryaḥ | atho yad annam aśnāti tad asyai viṣavattaram ||
6.23.d: अशम् अस्यै वातो वात्व् अशं तपतु सूर्यः । अथो यद् अन्नम् अश्नाति तद् अस्यै विषवत्तरम् ॥
6.23.m: Unkind let the wind blow for her, / unkind let the sun shine hot; / and whatever food she eats, / let that be more poisonous for her.

6.23.s: siṃhas te astu cakṣuṣa ity ekā ||
6.23.d: सिंहस् ते अस्तु चक्षुष इत्य् एका ॥
6.23.m: "May a lion be of your sight", thus [is] one [stanza].

6.23.s: eṣa vām agnir antarā sa viṣvañcau vy asyatu | yathā vāṃ na sahāsaty uttarasmiṃś canāyuṣi ||
6.23.d: एष वाम् अग्निर् अन्तरा स विष्वञ्चौ व्य् अस्यतु । यथा वां न सहासत्य् उत्तरस्मिंश् चनायुषि ॥
6.23.m: Here is Agni between the two of you; / may he scatter [you] in opposite directions, / so that the two of you will not be together / even in the further lifetime.

6.23.s: ut pātaya śimidāvati pra pātaya śimidāvati | imau vy asya dampatī pakvaṃ māṃsam ivāsinā ||
6.23.d: उत् पातय शिमिदावति प्र पातय शिमिदावति । इमौ व्य् अस्य दम्पती पक्वं मांसम् इवासिना ॥
6.23.m: Make [her] fly up, O possessed of Śimidā; / make [her] fly forth, O possessed of Śimidā! / Cut apart this married pair / like cooked meat with a knife.

6.23.s: meyam asmin patau raṃsta mo asmiñ chayane sve | jahātu vasanaṃ svam ahir jīrṇām iva tvacam ||
6.23.d: मेयम् अस्मिन् पतौ रंस्त मो अस्मिञ् छयने स्वे । जहातु वसनं स्वम् अहिर् जीर्णाम् इव त्वचम् ॥
6.23.m: Let this woman not take delight in this husband, / nor in her own bed. / Let her abandon her own dwelling / as a snake its worn-out skin.

6.23.s: yathā mṛtāś ca jīvāś ca asmiṃl loke vyokasaḥ | evemau dampatī stām asmiṃl loke vyokasau ||
6.23.d: यथा मृताश् च जीवाश् च अस्मिंल् लोके व्योकसः । एवेमौ दम्पती स्ताम् अस्मिंल् लोके व्योकसौ ॥
6.23.m: Just as the dead and the living / are of different homes in this world, / even so let this married pair / be of different homes in this world.

7.1.s: suparṇas tvānvavindat sūkaras tvākhanan nasā | dipsauṣadhe tvaṃ dipsantaṃ prati kṛtyākṛto daha ||
7.1.d: सुपर्णस् त्वान्वविन्दत् सूकरस् त्वाखनन् नसा । दिप्सौषधे त्वं दिप्सन्तं प्रति कृत्याकृतो दह ॥
7.1.m: The Suparṇa found you; / the boar dug you up with his snout. / Harm the harming one, O plant; / burn in return the sorcery-makers.

7.1.s: prati daha yātudhānān prati kṛtyākṛto daha | atho yo asmān dipsati tam u tvaṃ jahy oṣadhe ||
7.1.d: प्रति दह यातुधानान् प्रति कृत्याकृतो दह । अथो यो अस्मान् दिप्सति तम् उ त्वं जह्य् ओषधे ॥
7.1.m: Burn in return the sorcerers, / burn in return the sorcery-makers; / and also whoever wishes to harm us, / him do you strike down, O plant.

7.1.s: agne pṛtanāṣāṭ pṛtanāḥ sahasva | prati kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte pratiharaṇena harāmasi ||
7.1.d: अग्ने पृतनाषाट् पृतनाः सहस्व । प्रति कृत्यां कृत्याकृते प्रतिहरणेन हरामसि ॥
7.1.m: O Agni, conquering armies, overpower the armies! / We convey back the sorcery to the sorcery-maker / with a conveying back.

7.1.s: iṣvā ṛjīyaḥ patatu dyāvāpṛthivī tat sutāt | tat taṃ mṛga iva vidhyatu kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ kṛtā ||
7.1.d: इष्वा ऋजीयः पततु द्यावापृथिवी तत् सुतात् । तत् तं मृग इव विध्यतु कृत्या कृत्याकृतं कृता ॥
7.1.m: Let it fly straighter than an arrow / through heaven and earth! / Like a beast, let the wrought sorcery / pierce him, the sorcery-maker!

7.1.s: agham astv aghakṛte śapathāḥ śapathīvne | pratyak prati pra hiṇmasi yaś cakāra tam ṛcchatu ||
7.1.d: अघम् अस्त्व् अघकृते शपथाः शपथीव्ने । प्रत्यक् प्रति प्र हिण्मसि यश् चकार तम् ऋच्छतु ॥
7.1.m: Let evil belong to the evil-maker, / curses to the curser! / Backwards we send [it] back; / let it reach him who made it!

7.1.s: punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte hastagṛhya parā ṇaya | samakṣam asmā ā dadhmo yathā kṛtyākṛtaṃ hanat ||
7.1.d: पुनः कृत्यां कृत्याकृते हस्तगृह्य परा णय । समक्षम् अस्मा आ दध्मो यथा कृत्याकृतं हनत् ॥
